en: The doctor gently pressed on the patient's abdomen to find where the pain came from.
exzh: 醫生輕壓病人的腹部，想找出疼痛的來源。

zh: 王牌；高手；（網球）發球得分；頂尖的；擊敗
en: Our school's ace pitcher struck out ten players in the final game.
exzh: 我們學校的王牌投手在決賽中三振了十名打者。

zh: 聲學的；原音的；原音樂器
en: We enjoyed an acoustic concert with only a guitar and a violin.
exzh: 我們欣賞了一場只有吉他和小提琴的不插電音樂會。

en: Press this button to activate the alarm before you leave the building.
exzh: 離開大樓前請按這個按鈕啟動警報器。

en: All students must adhere to the rules of the science laboratory.
exzh: 所有學生都必須遵守科學實驗室的規定。

en: The library is adjacent to the gym, so it is easy to find.
exzh: 圖書館就在體育館隔壁，所以很容易找到。

en: The advent of smartphones has changed the way people take photos.
exzh: 智慧型手機的出現改變了人們拍照的方式。
note: 常指重要事物（新發明）的到來

zh: 天線的；空中的；空拍的；天線
en: The aerial photo shows the whole city and the river beside it.
exzh: 這張空拍照片呈現了整座城市和旁邊的河流。

en: He hopes to study aerospace engineering and help design new airplanes.
exzh: 他希望研讀航太工程，協助設計新型飛機。

en: The town worked together to rebuild homes in the aftermath of the typhoon.
exzh: 颱風過後，鎮上居民齊心協力重建家園。

en: The aggregate score of the two games decided which team moved on.
exzh: 兩場比賽的總得分決定了哪一隊晉級。

en: The mayor's aide handed her a note just before the speech began.
exzh: 演講開始前，市長的助理遞給她一張紙條。

en: Doing some light exercise every day can help alleviate back pain.
exzh: 每天做些輕度運動有助於減輕背痛。

en: Bronze is an alloy made mainly from copper and tin.
exzh: 青銅是主要由銅和錫製成的合金。

en: The library announced an amnesty, so late books could be returned without fines.
exzh: 圖書館宣布特赦，逾期的書可免罰款歸還。

en: Scientists in the Antarctic study how the ice has changed over time.
exzh: 南極地區的科學家研究冰層隨時間的變化。

en: The bug used its antenna to feel the surface of the leaf.
exzh: 那隻蟲用牠的觸角探測葉子的表面。
note: 昆蟲觸角複數 antennae；電視天線複數 antennas

en: The restaurant was closed after inspectors found appalling conditions in the kitchen.
exzh: 檢查人員發現廚房環境極差後，那家餐廳被勒令停業。

en: The students carefully set up the apparatus before starting the experiment.
exzh: 學生們在開始實驗前仔細架設好器材。

en: Each employee receives a yearly appraisal of his or her work.
exzh: 每位員工每年都會接受一次工作評估。

en: The teacher's choice of groups seemed arbitrary, so some students complained.
exzh: 老師分組的方式似乎很隨意，所以有些學生抱怨。

en: The ball flew in a high arc over the fence.
exzh: 球在空中劃出一道高高的弧線飛過圍牆。

en: Polar bears live in the Arctic and hunt seals on the ice.
exzh: 北極熊生活在北極地區，在冰上捕食海豹。

en: Blood flows from the heart through the arteries to the rest of the body.
exzh: 血液從心臟經由動脈流向身體其他部位。

en: The museum keeps many ancient artifacts that were found near the river.
exzh: 博物館收藏了許多在河邊發現的古代文物。

en: This book is the most authoritative guide to the birds of Taiwan.
exzh: 這本書是關於台灣鳥類最具權威的指南。

en: Self-driving cars are autonomous vehicles that can move without a human driver.
exzh: 自動駕駛汽車是不需人類駕駛就能行駛的自主車輛。

en: We tried to fix the old radio, but all our efforts were of no avail.
exzh: 我們試著修理那台舊收音機，但一切努力都徒勞無功。
note: to no avail 徒勞無功

en: The Earth turns on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
exzh: 地球每二十四小時繞著自己的軸自轉一圈。

en: The teacher asked us to include a bibliography at the end of our reports.
exzh: 老師要求我們在報告最後附上參考書目。

en: The soup was so bland that we added some salt and pepper.
exzh: 這碗湯太清淡了，所以我們加了一些鹽和胡椒。

en: The future looked bleak for the farmers after the long drought.
exzh: 長期乾旱之後，農民的前景顯得黯淡。

en: The blizzard buried the road under a meter of snow overnight.
exzh: 暴風雪一夜之間把道路埋在一公尺深的雪下。

en: Several nearby countries formed a trade bloc to help sell their products.
exzh: 幾個鄰近國家組成貿易集團，以幫助銷售他們的產品。

en: Ships could not enter the port during the blockade, so food became scarce.
exzh: 封鎖期間船隻無法進港，所以食物變得稀少。

en: The coach gave a short talk to bolster the team's confidence before the game.
exzh: 教練在比賽前簡短講話，以增強球隊的信心。

en: Please write the answer inside the brackets at the end of the line.
exzh: 請把答案寫在該行末尾的括號裡。
note: 也指年齡或收入的級距

en: The company was fined for breaching the rules about waste.
exzh: 那家公司因違反廢棄物相關規定而被罰款。

en: My grandmother likes to brew a pot of tea every afternoon.
exzh: 我奶奶喜歡每天下午沖一壺茶。
note: 亦可指醞釀，如 a storm is brewing

en: A soft pad acts as a buffer and protects the box from damage.
exzh: 柔軟的墊子能當作緩衝物，保護盒子不受損壞。

en: The artist made a bronze bust of the school's first principal.
exzh: 藝術家為學校第一任校長製作了一座青銅半身像。

en: The farmer gave milk to the newborn calf every morning.
exzh: 農夫每天早上餵剛出生的小牛喝奶。

en: We keep potatoes and apples in the cool cellar all winter.
exzh: 整個冬天我們都把馬鈴薯和蘋果存放在涼爽的地窖裡。

en: We cooked the fish over charcoal at the beach barbecue.
exzh: 我們在海灘烤肉時用木炭烤魚。

en: The teacher chuckled quietly when the little boy told his silly joke.
exzh: 小男孩講了個傻笑話，老師輕聲笑了起來。

en: Each clan in the village has its own traditional festival.
exzh: 村裡每個氏族都有自己的傳統節慶。

en: The little girl clutched her mother's hand tightly in the crowded station.
exzh: 在擁擠的車站裡，小女孩緊緊抓住媽媽的手。

en: The pilot checked every button in the cockpit before takeoff.
exzh: 起飛前，飛行員檢查了駕駛艙內的每個按鈕。

en: The sailor put the long rope in a neat coil on the deck.
exzh: 水手把長繩整齊地盤成一圈放在甲板上。

en: This year, the school's anniversary happens to coincide with the sports day.
exzh: 今年學校的校慶剛好和運動會同一天。

zh: 東山再起；捲土重來；反駁
en: The singer made a great comeback after being away from music for five years.
exzh: 那位歌手在離開樂壇五年後成功復出。

en: Every year the town holds a quiet ceremony to commemorate the people who built its first railway.
exzh: 每年，這個小鎮都會舉行一場安靜的儀式，紀念建造第一條鐵路的人們。
note: 常接事件或人物當受詞

en: The concert will commence at seven o'clock, so please take your seats before the lights go down.
exzh: 音樂會將在七點開始，所以請在燈光暗下之前入座。

en: Several families in the old building share a communal kitchen and a small garden on the roof.
exzh: 老公寓裡有幾戶人家共用一間公共廚房和一座屋頂小花園。

en: He put his heavy bag in the overhead compartment and then found his seat on the train.
exzh: 他把沉重的背包放進頭頂的置物隔間，然後在火車上找到自己的座位。

en: The bridge is built from a composite material that is lighter than steel but just as strong.
exzh: 這座橋是用一種比鋼輕、卻一樣堅固的複合材料建成的。

en: The engineer changed the configuration of the network so that every classroom could connect to the internet.
exzh: 工程師更改了網路的配置，好讓每間教室都能連上網際網路。

en: The company plans to consolidate its three small offices into one large building downtown.
exzh: 這家公司打算把三間小辦公室合併成市區的一棟大樓。

en: A consortium of universities is working together to build a telescope in the high mountains.
exzh: 一個由多所大學組成的聯盟正合作在高山上興建一座望遠鏡。

en: A conspicuous red sign at the entrance tells visitors to wash their hands before going in.
exzh: 入口處一面醒目的紅色告示要求訪客進入前先洗手。

en: The new mayor visited every part of her constituency to listen to what local people needed.
exzh: 新市長走訪她選區的每個角落，傾聽當地居民的需求。

en: Water is the main constituent of the human body, making up more than half of its weight.
exzh: 水是人體的主要成分，佔體重一半以上。

zh: 代表團；分遣隊；視情況而定的
en: A small contingent of students from our school traveled to the science fair in another city.
exzh: 我們學校有一小批學生代表前往另一個城市參加科展。

en: A convoy of trucks carried food and water to the villages that the flood had cut off.
exzh: 一列卡車車隊把食物和水運往被洪水切斷聯繫的村莊。

en: He pulled the cork out of the bottle of juice and poured a glass for each guest.
exzh: 他把軟木塞從果汁瓶中拔出來，為每位客人倒了一杯。

en: Scientists use powerful telescopes to study cosmic dust that floats between distant stars.
exzh: 科學家使用強大的望遠鏡研究漂浮在遙遠恆星之間的宇宙塵埃。

en: Taipei is a cosmopolitan city where visitors can find food and shops from many countries.
exzh: 臺北是一座國際化的城市，遊客在這裡能找到來自許多國家的美食和商店。

en: A courier brought the package to our door only a few hours after we ordered it online.
exzh: 網路下單後只過了幾個小時，快遞員就把包裹送到我們家門口。

en: A crooked old tree leans over the path, and children love to climb it after school.
exzh: 一棵彎彎曲曲的老樹斜靠在小路上，孩子們放學後都愛爬它。

en: The pie had a golden crust that was crisp on the outside and soft inside.
exzh: 這個派有一層金黃色的酥皮，外面酥脆，裡面柔軟。

en: The tank holds about two cubic meters of water, enough for the whole garden for a week.
exzh: 這個水槽大約能裝兩立方公尺的水，足夠整個花園使用一週。

en: A gas cylinder in the lab must be stored upright and kept away from heat.
exzh: 實驗室裡的氣體鋼瓶必須直立存放，並遠離熱源。

en: The king issued a decree that all children in the kingdom must learn to read.
exzh: 國王頒布了一道法令，規定全國的孩子都必須學習閱讀。

en: A deficiency of vitamin D can make bones weak, especially in children who rarely go outside.
exzh: 缺乏維生素 D 會使骨頭變脆弱，特別是在很少出門的孩子身上。

en: Diets that are deficient in iron can make people feel tired and dizzy.
exzh: 缺乏鐵質的飲食會讓人感到疲倦和頭暈。

en: The sudden demise of the small bookstore surprised the neighborhood, where it had stood for forty years.
exzh: 這家小書店突然歇業，讓鄰里居民很驚訝，它在這裡開了四十年。

en: Doctors were worried about the quick deterioration of the patient's health during the night.
exzh: 醫師們擔心病人的健康狀況在夜裡快速惡化。

en: The book is divided into three discrete parts, and each one can be read on its own.
exzh: 這本書分成三個各自獨立的部分，每一部分都能單獨閱讀。
note: 與 discreet（謹慎的）同音，易混淆

en: The strong wind helped to disperse the smoke, and the crowd could finally see the stage again.
exzh: 強風幫忙吹散了煙霧，群眾終於又能看見舞臺。

en: Good drainage in the fields keeps the farmers' crops from being damaged during a long period of rain.
exzh: 良好的田間排水，能避免農作物在長期降雨時受損。

en: The newspapers dubbed the young inventor the "Boy of Lights" after his lamp won a national prize.
exzh: 在那位年輕發明家的檯燈得到全國獎項後，報紙把他稱為「光之男孩」。

en: The librarian made a duplicate of the key so that two people could open the room.
exzh: 圖書館員複製了一把鑰匙，讓兩個人都能打開那間房間。

en: She was ecstatic when she learned that her class had won first place in the singing contest.
exzh: 得知全班在歌唱比賽中拿下第一名，她欣喜若狂。

en: The electoral office announced that students over eighteen can register to vote at their local school.
exzh: 選舉辦公室宣布，十八歲以上的學生可以在當地學校登記投票。

en: The new mayor promised to listen to the whole electorate, not just the people who voted for her.
exzh: 新市長承諾要傾聽全體選民的聲音，而不只是投給她的人。

en: An electron is a tiny particle with a negative charge that moves around the center of an atom.
exzh: 電子是一種帶負電的微小粒子，繞著原子的中心運動。

en: Only a small elite of runners in the country can finish the marathon in under two and a half hours.
exzh: 全國只有一小群頂尖跑者，能在兩個半小時內跑完馬拉松。

en: Passengers began to embark on the ferry at nine, and the ship left the harbor soon after.
exzh: 乘客們九點開始登上渡輪，船隻不久後就駛離港口。

zh: 實證的；以經驗為依據的
en: Scientists prefer empirical evidence from careful experiments to guesses that have no real support.
exzh: 科學家偏好來自嚴謹實驗的實證證據，而不是沒有實際根據的猜測。

en: The city council voted to enact a new rule that bans cars from the old market street.
exzh: 市議會投票通過新規定，禁止汽車進入老市場街。

en: Enzymes in our saliva begin to break down food as soon as we start chewing.
exzh: 我們唾液中的酵素在開始咀嚼時，就已經開始分解食物。

en: The teacher read us an ancient epic about a hero who crosses the sea to return home.
exzh: 老師唸了一部古代史詩給我們聽，內容是一位英雄渡海返家的故事。

en: A healthy diet and enough sleep help the body keep its equilibrium and fight off illness.
exzh: 健康的飲食與充足的睡眠，能幫助身體維持平衡並抵抗疾病。

en: Planting trees on the hills can help stop soil erosion during the rainy season.
exzh: 在山坡上種樹，有助於在雨季時防止土壤流失侵蝕。

en: If the two sides keep shouting, the small argument may escalate into a serious fight.
exzh: 如果雙方一直大吼，這場小爭吵可能會升級成嚴重的衝突。

en: The exam was exceedingly difficult, and only a few students finished all the questions in time.
exzh: 這次考試難得要命，只有少數學生來得及寫完所有題目。

en: The city holds a large exposition every year to show new inventions from many countries.
exzh: 這座城市每年舉辦一場大型博覽會，展示來自許多國家的新發明。

en: It seems extravagant to buy a new phone every year when the old one still works well.
exzh: 舊手機還能用卻每年都買新的，似乎很奢侈。

en: A long period without rain caused a terrible famine, and many families had little food to eat.
exzh: 長時間不下雨造成嚴重的饑荒，許多家庭幾乎沒有食物可吃。

en: Climbing the highest mountain in the country was a great feat for a group of young students.
exzh: 攀登全國最高的山，對一群年輕學生來說是了不起的壯舉。
note: 與 feet 發音相同；feat 讀 /fit/

en: A national federation of teachers organized a meeting to talk about how to use technology in class.
exzh: 一個全國性的教師聯合會舉辦聚會，討論如何在課堂上運用科技。

en: The dog showed great fidelity to its owner and waited by the door every evening for him.
exzh: 那隻狗對主人非常忠誠，每天傍晚都在門邊等他。

en: The old house still has its original light fixtures, which the owners decided to keep.
exzh: 這棟老房子仍保有原本的燈具，屋主決定保留它們。
note: 常用複數 fixtures and fittings

en: Tall trees flank the path to the school, giving shade to students on hot days.
exzh: 高大的樹木排列在通往學校的小路兩旁，在炎熱的日子替學生遮蔭。

en: The sailors fired a flare into the sky to show the rescue team where their boat was.
exzh: 水手們向天空發射一枚信號彈，讓救援隊知道他們船的位置。

en: He flicked the light switch on and began to read the instructions on the wall.
exzh: 他啪地打開電燈開關，開始閱讀牆上的說明。
note: 常見 flick through 快速翻閱

zh: 慘敗；砰地倒下；失敗之作
en: The new snack was a flop because most students found it too salty.
exzh: 這款新零食慘遭滑鐵盧，因為多數學生覺得太鹹了。

en: Quick action by the guards foiled the attempt to steal the painting.
exzh: 警衛的迅速行動挫敗了竊取那幅畫的企圖。

en: The news showed footage of the storm hitting the coastal town.
exzh: 新聞播放了風暴襲擊沿海小鎮的畫面。

en: She is one of the foremost scientists studying climate change in Asia.
exzh: 她是亞洲研究氣候變遷的頂尖科學家之一。

en: Several small shops are located on the fringe of the old town.
exzh: 有幾間小商店位在老城區的邊緣。

en: In the old factory, a huge furnace melted iron day and night.
exzh: 在那座老工廠裡，一座巨大的熔爐日夜不停地熔化鐵。

en: After a few meetings, our ideas began to gel into a clear plan.
exzh: 開了幾次會之後，我們的想法漸漸成形，變成一個清楚的計畫。
note: 可指計畫、想法逐漸成形

en: He wants to study geology because he loves hiking in the mountains.
exzh: 他想主修地質學，因為他熱愛在山中健行。

zh: 凹槽；溝；固定的生活模式
en: Rain had cut a deep groove into the soft ground along the path.
exzh: 雨水在小徑旁的軟土上沖出了一道深溝。
note: get into the groove 進入狀況

en: A small grove of tall trees provides shade for the picnic area.
exzh: 一小片高大的樹林為野餐區提供了遮蔭。

en: Hackers tried to hack into the school's network, but the security system stopped them.
exzh: 駭客試圖入侵學校的網路，但資安系統擋下了他們。
note: hack into 侵入（電腦系統）

en: Every new student receives a handbook that explains the school rules.
exzh: 每位新生都會收到一本說明校規的手冊。

en: Some hardy plants can survive the cold winters on the mountain.
exzh: 有些耐寒的植物能熬過山上寒冷的冬天。

en: The quiet library was a safe haven for students who needed to study.
exzh: 安靜的圖書館是需要讀書的學生的安全避風港。

en: Drivers should heed the warning signs when the road is wet.
exzh: 路面濕滑時，駕駛人應留意警告標誌。
note: 常用 heed a warning / pay heed to

en: He opened the hood of the car to check the engine.
exzh: 他打開車子的引擎蓋檢查引擎。
note: 美式指引擎蓋，英式為 bonnet

en: The ship's hull was damaged when it hit a rock near the shore.
exzh: 那艘船在岸邊撞到岩石，船體因此受損。

zh: 人道主義的；人道主義者
en: The charity sends food and medicine as humanitarian aid after floods.
exzh: 這個慈善團體在水災後送出食物與藥品作為人道援助。

en: The school choir sang a gentle hymn at the end of the ceremony.
exzh: 學校合唱團在典禮結束時唱了一首柔和的聖歌。

en: The crowd was hysterical with laughter at the comedian's story.
exzh: 觀眾被那位喜劇演員的故事逗得笑到不行。

en: A small spark can ignite dry grass during a hot summer.
exzh: 炎熱的夏天裡，一點小火花就能點燃乾草。

en: The incumbent mayor promised to build more parks if she won again.
exzh: 現任市長承諾，如果再度當選，會興建更多公園。

en: She came up with an ingenious way to save water at home.
exzh: 她想出了一個在家節水的巧妙方法。

en: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of many kinds of plants.
exzh: 寒冷的天氣會抑制許多植物的生長。

en: She lost her inhibition and began to sing loudly on stage.
exzh: 她放下了顧忌，開始在台上大聲唱歌。

zh: 不可或缺的；構成整體的
en: Teamwork is an integral part of every successful school project.
exzh: 團隊合作是每個成功的學校專題不可或缺的一部分。

en: An interim principal will lead the school until a new one is chosen.
exzh: 在選出新校長之前，由一位代理校長領導學校。
note: in the interim 在此期間

en: We had intermittent rain all afternoon, so the game kept stopping.
exzh: 整個下午斷斷續續地下雨，所以比賽一直中斷。

en: The craftsman carved an intricate pattern into the wooden box.
exzh: 工匠在木盒上雕刻了一幅精細複雜的圖案。

en: The painting has little intrinsic value, but it means a lot to my family.
exzh: 這幅畫本身的價值不高，但對我的家人意義重大。

zh: 無法抗拒的；極具誘惑的
en: The smell of hot soup on a cold day was simply irresistible.
exzh: 寒冷的日子裡，熱湯的香味簡直讓人無法抗拒。

en: Modern irrigation systems help farmers use less water to grow rice.
exzh: 現代的灌溉系統幫助農民用較少的水種稻。

en: A fair judiciary is important for protecting the rights of citizens.
exzh: 公正的司法體系對保障人民權利十分重要。

en: Inside the hard shell of the walnut is a soft, tasty kernel.
exzh: 核桃硬殼裡面是柔軟又美味的果仁。
note: the kernel of 核心要點

en: Hot lava flowed slowly down the side of the volcano.
exzh: 熾熱的熔岩緩緩流下火山的山坡。

zh: 槓桿；操縱桿；用槓桿撬動
en: He used a long stick as a lever to move the heavy rock.
exzh: 他用一根長棍當槓桿，來移動那塊沉重的岩石。

en: The government plans to levy a small tax on plastic bags.
exzh: 政府計畫對塑膠袋課徵一小筆稅。

en: This lightweight backpack is perfect for short trips and daily use.
exzh: 這個輕量背包很適合短途旅行與日常使用。

en: She squeezed a little lime into the water to give it a fresh taste.
exzh: 她擠了一點萊姆汁到水裡，讓它嚐起來更清新。

en: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
exzh: 這張圖顯示時間與距離之間呈線性關係。

en: Dark clouds loomed over the mountains, and the hikers hurried back.
exzh: 烏雲在山頭隱隱逼近，登山客趕緊折返。

en: The truck carried lumber to a site where a new house would be built.
exzh: 卡車載著木材前往要蓋新房子的工地。
note: 美式指木材，英式為 timber

en: The poet's lyric style makes even a simple walk in the rain sound beautiful.
exzh: 這位詩人的抒情風格，讓即使是雨中的簡單散步也顯得很美。

zh: 規模；重大程度；（地震）震級
en: Scientists measured the magnitude of the earthquake and reported it within a few minutes.
exzh: 科學家測量了這場地震的規模，並在幾分鐘內公布了結果。
note: 常見搭配：the magnitude of the problem

en: Mosquitoes can spread malaria, so travelers to some areas use nets while sleeping.
exzh: 蚊子會傳播瘧疾，所以前往某些地區的旅客睡覺時會使用蚊帳。

zh: 調動；機動操作；策略；演習
en: The driver carefully maneuvered the large truck through the narrow street without touching any car.
exzh: 司機小心翼翼地駕駛大卡車穿過狹窄的街道，沒有碰到任何一輛車。

en: The new club published a manifesto explaining its goals for protecting the river and the park.
exzh: 這個新社團發表了一份宣言，說明他們保護河川與公園的目標。

en: The farmer's mare gave birth to a healthy baby horse early this morning.
exzh: 農夫的母馬今天一早生下一隻健康的小馬。
note: 公馬是 stallion；小馬是 foal

en: Many kinds of birds live in the marsh near the river mouth.
exzh: 許多種鳥類棲息在河口附近的沼澤裡。

en: Please mash the boiled potatoes with a little milk until they become soft and smooth.
exzh: 請把煮好的馬鈴薯加一點牛奶搗成軟綿綿的泥。

zh: 威脅；危險的人事物；威嚇
en: Plastic waste is a serious menace to sea animals around the world.
exzh: 塑膠垃圾對全世界的海洋動物來說是嚴重的威脅。

en: Old thermometers used mercury, which can be harmful if it leaks out.
exzh: 舊式溫度計使用水銀，如果外漏可能會有害。

en: The robot made a loud metallic sound when its arm hit the table.
exzh: 機器人的手臂撞到桌子時，發出很大的金屬聲。

en: Most countries use the metric system, so distances are measured in kilometers instead of miles.
exzh: 大多數國家使用公制，所以距離以公里而不是英里計算。

en: The used car has low mileage, so it is still in very good condition.
exzh: 這輛二手車的里程數很低，所以狀況仍然非常好。

zh: 部長的；內閣的；政府部門的
en: The mayor said the plan still needs ministerial approval before work can begin.
exzh: 市長表示這項計畫在動工之前仍須取得部會的核准。

en: The bread was covered with green mold after being left in the kitchen for a week.
exzh: 這個麵包在廚房放了一個星期後，長滿了綠色的黴。

en: The builder mixed sand and water to make mortar for the brick wall.
exzh: 建築工人把沙和水混合，調成砌磚牆用的灰泥。

en: Visitors are asked to take off their shoes before entering the mosque.
exzh: 參觀者進入清真寺前，被要求先脫鞋。

en: Green moss grows on the stones near the stream because the air there is damp.
exzh: 溪邊的石頭上長著綠色的苔蘚，因為那裡的空氣很潮濕。

en: A multitude of stars appeared in the sky once the clouds moved away.
exzh: 雲層散開後，天空中出現了無數顆星星。
note: 常見搭配：a multitude of ...（大量的……）

en: The nanny picked up the children from school and cooked dinner for them.
exzh: 保姆到學校接孩子們，並為他們準備晚餐。

en: The new rule will take effect nationwide at the beginning of next month.
exzh: 這項新規定將在下個月初於全國實施。

en: The cost of this small repair is negligible compared with the price of a new machine.
exzh: 與買一台新機器的價錢相比，這次小修理的費用微不足道。

en: Neon lights lit up the busy street and made the night look colorful.
exzh: 霓虹燈照亮了熱鬧的街道，讓夜晚顯得色彩繽紛。
note: 常見搭配：neon sign / neon light

en: Nitrogen makes up most of the air that we breathe every day.
exzh: 氮占了我們每天呼吸的空氣的大部分。

zh: 名義上的；象徵性的；微小的
en: He pays only a nominal fee to use the community pool every month.
exzh: 他每個月只需付象徵性的費用就能使用社區游泳池。
note: 常見搭配：a nominal fee / nominal value

en: Notwithstanding the heavy rain, the school sports day continued as planned.
exzh: 儘管下著大雨，學校運動會仍照計畫進行。
note: 較正式；等於 despite / in spite of

en: The excitement of the new game was only a novelty, and soon people stopped playing it.
exzh: 這款新遊戲帶來的興奮只是一時的新鮮感，很快大家就不玩了。

zh: 麻煩的人事物；討厭的東西
en: The loud noise from the building site is a real nuisance for the neighbors.
exzh: 工地傳來的巨大噪音對鄰居來說真是一大困擾。

en: Please put the files in numerical order so that we can find them easily.
exzh: 請把檔案依數字順序排好，這樣我們才容易找到。

en: Planting more trees can help offset the carbon released by cars and factories.
exzh: 多種一些樹有助於抵銷汽車和工廠所排放的碳。

en: The window glass was opaque, so no one could see what was inside the room.
exzh: 那片窗玻璃是不透明的，所以沒有人看得到房裡有什麼。

en: The doctor used an optical machine to check the shape of my eyes.
exzh: 醫生用一台光學儀器檢查我的眼睛形狀。
note: 常見搭配：optical illusion（視覺錯覺）

en: Tomatoes grow best at an optimum temperature of about twenty-five degrees.
exzh: 番茄在大約二十五度的最適溫度下生長得最好。

en: Workers dug the iron ore out of the mountain and carried it to the factory by train.
exzh: 工人從山裡挖出鐵礦石，再用火車運到工廠。

en: There was no overt sign of trouble, but the team felt something was wrong.
exzh: 雖然沒有明顯的麻煩跡象，但團隊覺得事情不太對勁。

en: Rust is a kind of iron oxide that forms when metal stays wet for a long time.
exzh: 鏽是一種氧化鐵，金屬長時間潮濕就會形成。

en: The two neighboring countries signed a pact to protect the river that runs between them.
exzh: 這兩個鄰國簽署了一項協定，保護流經兩國之間的河川。

en: The teacher explained the parameters of the project, including the deadline and the length.
exzh: 老師說明了這項專題的各項限制，包括繳交期限和長度。

en: The country has a parliamentary system, so the leader is chosen by members of parliament.
exzh: 這個國家採行議會制，所以領導人由國會議員選出。

en: The teacher put a partition between the desks so that students could focus on the exam.
exzh: 老師在課桌之間放了隔板，讓學生能專心考試。

zh: 長年的；多年生的；多年生植物
en: Flooding is a perennial problem in this low area, and it returns almost every summer.
exzh: 淹水是這個低窪地區長年的問題，幾乎每年夏天都會出現。
note: 園藝中指多年生植物，對照 annual（一年生）

en: The scientists made periodic visits to the island to count the number of birds.
exzh: 科學家定期造訪這座島嶼，統計鳥類的數量。

zh: 永久的；無休止的；不斷的
en: The old man's perpetual complaints about the noise made the neighbors tired.
exzh: 那位老先生不斷抱怨噪音，讓鄰居們都感到厭煩。

en: The lawyer asked only pertinent questions so that the meeting would end on time.
exzh: 律師只問相關的問題，使會議能準時結束。

en: The pharmaceutical company spent ten years developing a new medicine for allergies.
exzh: 這家製藥公司花了十年時間研發一種新的過敏藥物。

en: Exercise brings physiological changes such as a stronger heart and better sleep.
exzh: 運動會帶來生理上的變化，例如更強健的心臟和更好的睡眠。

en: In biology class, we studied the physiology of the human heart and lungs.
exzh: 在生物課上，我們學習了人類心臟和肺部的生理機能。

zh: 石膏；灰泥；塗灰泥；貼膏藥
en: The doctor put a plaster cast on his arm after he fell from the bike.
exzh: 他從腳踏車上摔下來後，醫生幫他的手臂打上了石膏。
note: 打石膏常說 a plaster cast

en: The village sits on a high plateau, so the weather there is cool all year.
exzh: 這個村莊位在高原上，所以那裡全年天氣涼爽。

zh: 似乎合理的；貌似可信的
en: His explanation sounded plausible, but the teacher still wanted to see the proof.
exzh: 他的解釋聽起來很合理，但老師還是想看證據。

en: The news report described the plight of families who lost their homes in the flood.
exzh: 新聞報導描述了在洪水中失去家園的家庭的困境。

zh: 蓄勢待發的；做好準備的；懸而未決的
en: The runners stood poised at the starting line, waiting for the signal to go.
exzh: 跑者們蓄勢待發地站在起跑線上，等待出發的信號。
note: 常見搭配：poised to V（準備好要……）

en: Long ago, huge herds of buffalo lived on the open prairie in North America.
exzh: 很久以前，大群野牛生活在北美遼闊的大草原上。

en: The class is predominantly made up of girls who enjoy science.
exzh: 這個班級大多由喜歡科學的女生組成。

en: Colds are especially prevalent among young children in the winter.
exzh: 感冒在冬天的幼兒之間特別普遍。

en: He propped the door open with a chair so that the fresh air could come in.
exzh: 他用一張椅子把門撐開，讓新鮮空氣進來。

zh: 提議；主張；命題；提出建議
en: The company has made a new proposition that will lower the cost of train tickets.
exzh: 這家公司提出了一項能降低火車票價的新提案。

zh: 挑釁的；引人爭議的；煽動性的
en: The speaker's provocative question made the whole audience start arguing about the topic.
exzh: 講者那個引人爭議的問題，讓全體聽眾開始爭論這個話題。

en: We chose this apartment for its proximity to the school and the train station.
exzh: 我們選擇這間公寓，是因為它離學校和火車站很近。
note: 常見搭配：in close proximity to ...

en: The hospital has a psychiatric department that helps people with serious anxiety.
exzh: 這家醫院設有精神科，協助有嚴重焦慮的人。

en: The scientists did a qualitative study by interviewing students about how they use phones.
exzh: 科學家訪談學生如何使用手機，做了一項質性的研究。

en: Quantitative research uses numbers and charts to show how much something has changed.
exzh: 量化研究使用數字與圖表來呈現某件事改變了多少。

en: Quantum physics studies the behavior of very small particles such as atoms and electrons.
exzh: 量子物理學研究原子和電子等非常微小的粒子的行為。
note: 常見搭配：quantum leap（巨大的躍進）

en: The string quartet played a quiet piece of music in the school hall.
exzh: 這個弦樂四重奏在學校禮堂演奏了一首安靜的曲子。

en: Many watches use a small piece of quartz to keep accurate time.
exzh: 許多手錶使用一小塊石英來準確計時。

en: If you have any query about the schedule, please send an email to the teacher.
exzh: 如果你對時間表有任何疑問，請寄電子郵件給老師。

en: The fisherman slowly reeled in the line and found a large fish at the end of it.
exzh: 漁夫慢慢捲收釣線，發現線的另一端有一條大魚。

en: Visitors are asked to refrain from using flash photography inside the museum.
exzh: 請參觀者在博物館內避免使用閃光燈拍照。

en: She relished the chance to explain her science project to the whole class.
exzh: 她很享受有機會向全班同學說明自己的科學專題。

en: Only a small remnant of the old forest survived the construction of the highway.
exzh: 在公路興建之後，古老森林只剩下一小片殘存。

en: Many great paintings and inventions came from the Renaissance in Italy during the fifteenth century.
exzh: 許多偉大的畫作與發明都出自十五世紀義大利的文藝復興時期。
note: 指歐洲文藝復興時首字母大寫。

zh: （演出者的）全部曲目；全部技能
en: The young pianist has a large repertoire that includes both classical and modern pieces.
exzh: 這位年輕鋼琴家的曲目很廣，包括古典與現代作品。

en: The new train line will reportedly cut the travel time between the two cities in half.
exzh: 據報導，這條新鐵路線將把兩個城市之間的車程縮短一半。

en: Many historians study how repression of free speech affected daily life in the past.
exzh: 許多歷史學家研究過去對言論自由的壓制如何影響日常生活。

en: The deep resonance of the cello filled the concert hall and made the audience fall silent.
exzh: 大提琴低沉的共鳴充滿音樂廳，讓觀眾安靜下來。

en: Good sleep improves memory retention, which helps students remember what they learned in class.
exzh: 良好的睡眠能提升記憶保持力，幫助學生記住在課堂上學到的內容。

en: The museum is holding a retrospective exhibition of the painter's work from the past forty years.
exzh: 博物館正在舉辦這位畫家過去四十年作品的回顧展。

en: The report said someone tried to rig the online vote so that one team would win.
exzh: 報導指出有人企圖操縱網路投票，好讓某一隊獲勝。
note: 常見搭配：oil rig、rig an election

en: In many cultures, a special rite marks the moment when a young person becomes an adult.
exzh: 在許多文化中，會用一種特別的儀式來標誌年輕人成年的時刻。
note: 常見搭配：rite of passage（成年禮、人生重要階段）

en: My roommate and I take turns cleaning the kitchen and washing the dishes every week.
exzh: 我和室友每週輪流打掃廚房和洗碗。

en: The old machine uses a rotary motor to turn the large wheel at a steady speed.
exzh: 這台老機器用旋轉馬達讓大輪子以穩定的速度轉動。

en: The museum displays a large ruby that was found in a mountain mine hundreds of years ago.
exzh: 博物館展示著一顆數百年前在山區礦場挖出的大紅寶石。

zh: 野生動物觀賞之旅；狩獵旅行
en: The family went on a safari in Africa and saw lions, elephants, and giraffes in the wild.
exzh: 這家人到非洲參加野生動物觀賞之旅，在野外看到獅子、大象和長頸鹿。

en: New rules were introduced to safeguard the personal information of students who use the school website.
exzh: 新規定出爐以保護使用學校網站的學生的個人資料。

en: The bird sanctuary near the lake protects thousands of rare birds every winter.
exzh: 湖邊的鳥類保護區每年冬天保護著數千隻稀有的鳥。

en: It does not seem sane to drive so fast on a road covered with ice.
exzh: 在結冰的路上開那麼快似乎不太明智。

en: The two companies worked in complete secrecy so that their new product would be a surprise.
exzh: 兩家公司在完全保密的情況下合作，好讓新產品成為一個驚喜。

en: The senate voted on the new law after several days of careful discussion and debate.
exzh: 參議院在經過數天審慎討論和辯論後，就這項新法律進行表決。

en: Workers went down the long mine shaft to check the safety of the tunnel.
exzh: 工人沿著長長的礦井豎坑下去檢查隧道的安全。

en: Thousands of visitors walk to the mountain shrine every year to enjoy its quiet beauty.
exzh: 每年有數千位訪客步行前往山上的神社，欣賞它寧靜的美。

en: The crab walks sideways across the sand, which looks funny to young children at the beach.
exzh: 螃蟹橫著走過沙灘，這在海邊的小朋友看來很好笑。

en: Silicon is widely used to make computer chips because of its special electrical properties.
exzh: 矽因為其特殊的導電性質而被廣泛用來製造電腦晶片。

en: The software can simulate how a storm moves across the ocean and where it may land.
exzh: 這套軟體可以模擬風暴如何越過海洋，以及可能在哪裡登陸。

en: Pilots practice in a flight simulation before they fly a real airplane with passengers.
exzh: 飛行員在駕駛載客的真正飛機之前，會先在飛行模擬中練習。

en: The empty house looked sinister under the gray sky, and no one wanted to go near it.
exzh: 在灰暗的天空下，那間空屋看起來很不祥，沒有人想靠近。

en: Business is slack in winter, so the small hotel gives its staff a longer holiday.
exzh: 冬季生意清淡，所以這間小旅館讓員工放較長的假。
note: 常見搭配：cut sb. some slack

zh: 石板；候選人名單；（用石板）覆蓋
en: The roof of the old cottage was covered with gray slate that shone in the rain.
exzh: 老農舍的屋頂覆蓋著灰色石板，在雨中閃閃發亮。

en: After the oil leak, a thick slick spread across the sea and harmed many seabirds.
exzh: 漏油之後，一大片厚厚的油膜在海面擴散，傷害了許多海鳥。

en: The ball hit the window with a loud smack, and everyone in the classroom looked up.
exzh: 球啪的一聲打到窗戶上，教室裡的每個人都抬頭看。

en: The soundtrack of the film was so moving that many viewers bought the album afterward.
exzh: 這部電影的配樂非常動人，許多觀眾後來都買了專輯。

en: Playing with building blocks helps young children develop spatial skills that are useful in math.
exzh: 玩積木有助於幼兒發展對數學有用的空間能力。

en: The number of visitors showed a sudden spike during the holiday week at the beach.
exzh: 假期那一週，海邊的遊客人數突然急遽上升。
note: 常見搭配：a spike in sth.

en: He made a sprint for the bus and jumped on just before the doors closed.
exzh: 他衝刺跑向公車，在車門關上前一刻跳了上去。

en: From a scientific standpoint, the experiment proved that plants grow faster with more light.
exzh: 從科學的角度看，這個實驗證明植物在光線充足時長得更快。

en: My sweater was full of static, and my hair stood up when I took it off.
exzh: 我的毛衣充滿靜電，脫下來時頭髮都豎了起來。

en: Employers must pay the statutory minimum wage to every worker in the country.
exzh: 雇主必須對全國每位勞工支付法定的最低工資。

en: The captain stood at the stern of the ship and watched the harbor slowly disappear.
exzh: 船長站在船尾，看著港口慢慢消失。
note: 形容詞義「嚴厲的」：a stern teacher

en: The basketball team is on a winning streak and has not lost a game this month.
exzh: 這支籃球隊正處於連勝期，這個月還沒輸過任何一場比賽。
note: 常見搭配：winning streak、a streak of luck

en: The actor trained for months so that he could perform the dangerous stunt safely.
exzh: 那位演員訓練了好幾個月，才能安全地完成這項危險的特技。

en: The company opened a subsidiary overseas in order to sell its products to more customers.
exzh: 公司在海外開設子公司，以便把產品賣給更多顧客。

en: Young children are more susceptible to colds, so they should wash their hands often.
exzh: 幼童比較容易感冒，所以應該常洗手。
note: 常見搭配：be susceptible to sth.

en: Scientists from ten countries gathered at a symposium to discuss ways to protect the oceans.
exzh: 來自十個國家的科學家聚集在研討會上，討論保護海洋的方法。

en: English syntax usually puts the subject before the verb, which is different from some other languages.
exzh: 英文句法通常把主詞放在動詞之前，這和某些其他語言不同。

en: Plants use sunlight in the synthesis of sugar, which gives them the energy they need to grow.
exzh: 植物利用陽光合成糖分，而糖分提供它們生長所需的能量。

en: In some cultures, talking about how much money you earn is considered a taboo.
exzh: 在某些文化裡，談論自己賺多少錢被視為禁忌。
note: 也可作形容詞：a taboo subject

en: The takeover of the small bookstore by a large company surprised many loyal customers.
exzh: 大公司收購那家小書店的消息讓許多老顧客感到意外。

zh: 計分；記錄；總數；（數目）相符
en: The teacher kept a tally of how many books each student had read this semester.
exzh: 老師記錄每位學生這學期讀了幾本書。
note: 作動詞：tally up 加總；tally with 吻合

en: Workers poured hot tar on the road to repair the holes caused by heavy rain.
exzh: 工人在路面倒上熱柏油，修補大雨造成的坑洞。
note: 香菸中的焦油亦稱 tar

en: The government raised the tariff on imported steel to protect local factories.
exzh: 政府提高了進口鋼鐵的關稅，以保護本地工廠。

en: He has a small tattoo of a bird on his arm, which he got on his twentieth birthday.
exzh: 他手臂上有一個小小的鳥類刺青，是二十歲生日時刺的。

en: Every taxpayer has the right to know how the city spends the money it collects.
exzh: 每位納稅人都有權知道市政府如何運用所徵收的錢。

en: My teammate passed me the ball just before the whistle, and I scored the winning point.
exzh: 哨聲響起前我的隊友把球傳給我，我拿下了致勝的一分。

en: The dog has a calm temperament, so it is a good friend for young children.
exzh: 這隻狗性情溫和，很適合當小朋友的好夥伴。

en: The company decided to terminate the contract because the supplier kept delivering late.
exzh: 由於供應商一再延遲交貨，公司決定終止合約。

en: The termination of the program was announced after the money for it ran out.
exzh: 計畫因經費用完而宣布終止。

en: Doctors use special terminology that can be hard for ordinary people to understand.
exzh: 醫生使用的專門術語，一般人可能很難理解。

en: The rough terrain made it difficult for the bicycle race to continue across the mountains.
exzh: 崎嶇的地形使自行車賽很難繼續穿越山區。

en: Frogs live both in water and on land, but snakes are mainly terrestrial animals.
exzh: 青蛙既生活在水中也生活在陸地上，但蛇主要是陸生動物。

en: Tertiary education includes universities and colleges that students attend after finishing high school.
exzh: 第三級教育包括學生高中畢業後就讀的大學與學院。
note: tertiary industry 第三級產業（服務業）

en: The beautiful old bridge is a testament to the skill of the workers who built it.
exzh: 這座美麗的古橋證明了建造者的高超技術。

en: The school club prepared a theatrical show with costumes, music, and a large painted stage.
exzh: 學校社團準備了一場有戲服、音樂和大型彩繪舞台的戲劇表演。

zh: 熱的；保暖的；上升熱氣流
en: In winter, I wear thermal underwear to stay warm on my way to school.
exzh: 冬天我穿保暖內衣，在上學的路上保持溫暖。

en: The toddler laughed happily as he chased the soap bubbles around the yard.
exzh: 那個學步的小男孩一邊在院子裡追著肥皂泡泡，一邊開心地笑。

zh: 一大片土地；（消化等）系統
en: A large tract of forest was protected to give wild animals a safe place to live.
exzh: 一大片森林被保護起來，好讓野生動物有安全的棲息地。

en: The farmer used a tractor to pull the heavy plow across the wide field.
exzh: 農夫用曳引機拉著沉重的犁耙越過寬闊的田地。

en: The warm weather was only transient, and cold rain returned the very next day.
exzh: 溫暖的天氣只是短暫的，隔天就又下起冷雨。

en: The hikers needed three days to traverse the long mountain ridge.
exzh: 登山客花了三天才橫越那條長長的山稜。

zh: 危險的；暗藏危機的；背信的
en: The icy road was treacherous, so the bus driver slowed down and drove very carefully.
exzh: 結冰的路面很危險，所以公車司機放慢速度，小心翼翼地開車。

en: Workers dug a long trench beside the road to put new water pipes underground.
exzh: 工人在路旁挖了一條長溝，好把新的水管埋入地下。
note: the Mariana Trench 馬里亞納海溝

en: The workers took their complaint to a tribunal to ask for fair treatment.
exzh: 工人們把申訴提交給審裁委員會，要求公平的對待。

en: The school music trio, made up of a pianist, a violinist, and a singer, won first prize.
exzh: 這個由鋼琴手、小提琴手和歌手組成的校內三人組合贏得了第一名。

en: The two sides agreed to a truce so that food and medicine could reach the villages.
exzh: 雙方同意休戰，好讓食物和藥品能送到村莊。

en: Tuberculosis was once a common disease, but today doctors can treat it with medicine.
exzh: 結核病曾經很常見，但現在醫生可以用藥物治療。

en: A wind turbine uses the power of moving air to produce clean electricity.
exzh: 風力渦輪機利用流動空氣的力量來產生乾淨的電力。

en: The plane shook for a few minutes as it passed through turbulent air.
exzh: 飛機穿過亂流時，劇烈搖晃了幾分鐘。

zh: 營業額；人事流動率；翻轉
en: The shop's turnover rose sharply after it started selling products on the Internet.
exzh: 這家店開始在網路上銷售商品後，營業額大幅上升。
note: 也指員工離職率 staff turnover；或「餡餅」

en: The people in the story finally rose up against the tyranny of the cruel king.
exzh: 故事中的人民終於起身反抗殘暴國王的暴政。

en: The tyrant ruled the country with fear and forced everyone to obey his rules.
exzh: 那位暴君以恐懼統治國家，強迫所有人服從他的規定。

en: Her kind upbringing taught her to respect others and always help people in need.
exzh: 她所受的溫和教養，教她尊重別人並隨時幫助有需要的人。

en: Uranium is a heavy metal that some power plants use as fuel to make electricity.
exzh: 鈾是一種重金屬，部分發電廠把它當作燃料來發電。

en: The nurse took the utmost care to keep the baby warm and safe.
exzh: 護理師極其小心地讓寶寶保持溫暖與安全。

en: The firefighters made a valiant effort to save the old building from the flames.
exzh: 消防員英勇地努力要把那棟老建築從火海中救出來。

en: Turn the valve slowly to let the water flow into the garden pipe.
exzh: 慢慢轉動閥門，讓水流進花園的水管裡。

en: Scientists measured the velocity of the ball as it fell from the top of the tower.
exzh: 科學家測量了球從塔頂落下時的速度。
note: 物理上 velocity 有方向，speed 沒有方向

en: Warm air flows out of the vent near the window and heats the whole classroom.
exzh: 暖空氣從窗邊的通風口吹出，使整間教室暖和起來。

en: The old company was on the verge of closing when a new owner saved it.
exzh: 這家老公司瀕臨倒閉時，一位新老闆救了它。
note: on the verge of 瀕臨；作動詞：verge on 接近

en: There are two hospitals and several schools in the vicinity of the train station.
exzh: 火車站附近有兩家醫院和好幾所學校。
note: in the vicinity of 在……附近

zh: 年份古董的；經典老款；（酒）年份
en: He loves collecting vintage cameras from the 1960s and displays them on a shelf.
exzh: 他喜歡蒐集一九六零年代的經典老相機，並把它們陳列在架子上。
note: 名詞可指葡萄酒的「年份」

en: My uncle still plays old music on vinyl records because he likes the warm sound.
exzh: 我叔叔因為喜歡那種溫暖的聲音，至今仍用黑膠唱片播放老歌。

en: Short hair was in vogue among young students when my mother was in high school.
exzh: 我媽媽念高中時，短髮在年輕學生之間很流行。
note: in vogue 流行；out of vogue 退流行

zh: 空白；空虛；無效的；使無效
en: The loss of her old friend left a void in her life that took time to fill.
exzh: 失去老朋友在她的生活中留下一片空缺，需要時間來填補。
note: 形容詞：null and void 無效的

zh: 不穩定的；易揮發的；易變的
en: Oil prices have been volatile this year, rising and falling many times in a few months.
exzh: 今年油價很不穩定，短短幾個月內漲跌了許多次。

en: Check the voltage of the power outlet before you use a device from another country.
exzh: 在使用來自其他國家的電器前，先檢查插座的電壓。

en: The teacher asked the students not to use vulgar words in the school play.
exzh: 老師要求學生在學校的戲劇中不要使用粗俗的字眼。

en: The children rolled up their pants and waded into the shallow river to catch small fish.
exzh: 孩子們捲起褲管，涉入淺淺的河中抓小魚。

en: I put a small wedge under the door to keep it open in the warm breeze.
exzh: 我在門下塞了一個小楔子，讓門在暖風中保持敞開。
note: 作動詞：wedge sth in 把某物塞進去

en: The old stone house has withstood many storms over the past two hundred years.
exzh: 這棟老石屋在過去兩百年裡承受了許多次暴風雨。

en: We took a quiet walk through the woodland and listened to the birds singing.
exzh: 我們在林地裡安靜地散步，聽著鳥兒歌唱。

en: The traveler felt wretched after walking in the cold rain for hours without food.
exzh: 旅人在冷雨中不吃東西走了好幾個小時，覺得淒慘極了。

en: My grandmother used colorful yarn to knit a warm scarf for each of her grandchildren.
exzh: 奶奶用彩色毛線為每個孫子織了一條溫暖的圍巾。

en: Yeast makes bread dough rise by producing tiny bubbles of gas inside it.
exzh: 酵母在麵糰內產生細小的氣泡，使麵包麵糰膨脹。

en: Zinc is a metal used to cover steel so that it does not rust easily.
exzh: 鋅是一種金屬，用來包覆鋼鐵，使它不容易生鏽。
note: 人體所需的微量元素之一

en: The findings of the study show that students who sleep eight hours score higher on tests.
exzh: 這項研究的結果顯示，睡滿八小時的學生考試成績比較高。
note: 常用複數；the findings of a study

en: The company reported higher earnings this year because more customers bought its new line of electric bicycles.
exzh: 這家公司今年的盈餘增加，因為更多顧客購買了它的新款電動自行車。
note: 常用複數；earnings report 財報

en: The comedian told a hilarious story about getting lost in his own hometown, and the whole audience laughed.
exzh: 那位喜劇演員講了一個在自己家鄉迷路的爆笑故事，全場觀眾都笑了。

en: The new cooking show earned high ratings, so the network decided to make a second season this winter.
exzh: 這個新的料理節目收視率很高，所以電視台決定今年冬天推出第二季。

en: A new regulatory agency will check whether food factories follow safety rules every year.
exzh: 一個新的監管機構將每年檢查食品工廠是否遵守安全規定。

zh: 訴訟程序；會議紀錄；議事
en: The school board will publish the proceedings of Monday's meeting on its website so parents can read them.
exzh: 學校董事會將把週一會議的紀錄公布在網站上，讓家長閱讀。

en: The stadium has three tiers of seats, and the cheapest tickets are on the top tier.
exzh: 這座體育場有三層座位，最便宜的票在最上層。

en: Hospital staff must follow a strict protocol when they wash their hands before entering the patient's room.
exzh: 醫院人員在進入病房前洗手時，必須遵守嚴格的規程。
note: 常指一套標準程序，如 safety protocol

en: The iconic tower has become the symbol of the city and attracts millions of visitors.
exzh: 這座標誌性的塔已成為這個城市的象徵，吸引數百萬名遊客。

en: The river forms a border, so the two cities share jurisdiction over the safety of the bridge.
exzh: 這條河形成邊界，因此兩個城市共同管轄這座橋的安全。
note: under the jurisdiction of 在…管轄之下

en: The test was seemingly easy at first, but many students ran out of time before finishing.
exzh: 這份考卷起初看似簡單，但許多學生還沒寫完就沒時間了。

en: Good governance means that a city explains its decisions clearly and listens to what its citizens need.
exzh: 良好的治理意味著城市會清楚說明決策，並傾聽市民的需求。

en: The company denied the allegations that it had polluted the river near the factory.
exzh: 該公司否認了有關它污染工廠附近河川的指控。

en: Taoyuan Airport serves as an important transport hub that connects travelers from many parts of Asia.
exzh: 桃園機場是重要的交通樞紐，連結亞洲許多地方的旅客。

en: In math class, we learned that a matrix is a set of numbers arranged in rows and columns.
exzh: 在數學課上，我們學到矩陣是一組排列成列與行的數字。

en: The median score of the class was 78, which was slightly higher than last year's median.
exzh: 全班分數的中位數是七十八分，比去年的中位數略高一些。
note: mean 平均數、median 中位數、mode 眾數

zh: 令人毛骨悚然的；陰森的
en: The old house looked creepy at night, so the children were afraid to walk past it.
exzh: 那棟老房子夜裡看起來陰森森的，所以孩子們不敢從旁邊走過。

en: The exam was very difficult; nonetheless, most students stayed calm and finished every question on time.
exzh: 這次考試非常困難；儘管如此，大多數學生仍保持冷靜，準時寫完每一題。
note: 與 nevertheless 同義，較正式

en: Despite all the hype before its release, the new phone turned out to be quite ordinary.
exzh: 儘管上市前大肆宣傳，這支新手機其實相當普通。
note: 常搭配 live up to the hype（名副其實）

en: The video app uses a clever algorithm to suggest new clips that match what you usually enjoy.
exzh: 這個影片應用程式用一套巧妙的演算法，推薦符合你平常喜好的新短片。

en: The engineers set the parameters of the experiment before they started to collect any data.
exzh: 工程師在開始蒐集任何資料之前，先設定好實驗的參數。

en: The museum received a large donation of paintings from the family of a deceased local artist.
exzh: 博物館收到一位已故在地藝術家家屬捐贈的大批畫作。
note: 亦可作名詞 the deceased 死者

en: Taiwan has a long maritime history, and its ports have connected people across the sea for centuries.
exzh: 臺灣有悠久的海洋歷史，數百年來，它的港口一直連結著海洋彼岸的人們。

en: Computers store information in binary code, which uses only the two digits zero and one.
exzh: 電腦以二進位碼儲存資訊，只用到零和一這兩個數字。

en: Many countries agreed to place economic sanctions on the nation that broke the trade agreement.
exzh: 許多國家同意對違反貿易協定的那個國家實施經濟制裁。
note: impose sanctions on 對…實施制裁

en: Many public schools offer a secular education that focuses on science, language, and history.
exzh: 許多公立學校提供以科學、語言和歷史為主的非宗教教育。

en: Before buying a laptop, check the specifications to see how much memory and storage it has.
exzh: 買筆電之前，先看看規格，了解它有多少記憶體和儲存空間。

en: Students in the biology club studied the anatomy of a frog to learn how its organs work together.
exzh: 生物社的學生研究青蛙的解剖構造，了解牠的器官如何互相配合。

en: Plants need optimal amounts of water and sunlight in order to grow as tall as possible.
exzh: 植物需要最適量的水分與陽光，才能長得盡可能高大。

en: Many elderly people lost money to a phone scam in which callers pretended to be from their bank.
exzh: 許多年長者因假冒銀行人員的電話詐騙而損失金錢。
note: 常見搭配 online scam；動詞 scam sb. out of sth.

en: Words like "and" and "but" are conjunctions that join two parts of a sentence together.
exzh: and 和 but 這類字是連接詞，用來把句子的兩個部分連在一起。
note: in conjunction with 表「與……共同」

en: After a long tenure as school principal, she retired and spent more time travelling with her family.
exzh: 長期擔任校長之後，她退休了，花更多時間與家人旅行。

zh: 人口統計的；（特定）族群；客群
en: Teenagers are an important demographic for companies that make video games and mobile apps.
exzh: 青少年是製作電玩遊戲與手機應用程式的公司的重要客群。
note: 名詞常指市場上的族群

en: The science fair is a great showcase for the creative projects that students have worked on all year.
exzh: 科展是展現學生一整年創意作品的絕佳場合。

en: The team made progress, albeit slowly, and finally finished the project a week after the deadline.
exzh: 這個團隊雖然緩慢但確實有進展，最後在截止日一週後完成了專案。

en: Her advocacy for cleaner rivers inspired many young people to join the weekend clean-up activities.
exzh: 她對乾淨河川的倡導，激勵許多年輕人參加週末的淨溪活動。
note: 動詞 advocate；常與 for 連用

en: Soccer is arguably the most popular sport in the world, played by people of all ages.
exzh: 可以說足球是全世界最受歡迎的運動，各年齡層的人都在踢。

zh: 嵌入的；內建的；根深蒂固的
en: Most modern phones have an embedded camera that can take sharp photos even in dim light.
exzh: 大多數現代手機都有內建相機，在昏暗的光線下也能拍出清晰的照片。

zh: 槓桿作用；籌碼；影響力；利用
en: The small company used its local knowledge as leverage to win a contract from a bigger firm.
exzh: 這家小公司利用自己對當地的了解作為籌碼，贏得了一家大公司的合約。

en: The old bridge became problematic after the heavy rain, so engineers closed it for safety checks.
exzh: 大雨過後那座老橋出了問題，所以工程師為了安全檢查而將它封閉。

en: The city council voted to repeal the old rule that banned bicycles from the main road.
exzh: 市議會投票廢除那條禁止腳踏車行駛於主要道路的舊規定。
note: repeal a law 廢除法律

zh: 傳奇故事；長篇故事；連續事件
en: The old Viking saga tells of brave sailors who crossed the cold sea to find new land.
exzh: 這部古老的北歐傳奇講述勇敢的水手橫越冰冷的海洋尋找新土地。
note: 亦可指冗長、複雜的連續事件

en: Organizing a school trip involves a lot of logistics, such as buses, meals, and schedules.
exzh: 籌辦校外旅行涉及許多後勤工作，例如遊覽車、餐點和行程安排。

en: A positive mindset can help you keep trying even when a school project becomes difficult.
exzh: 正向的心態能幫助你在學校專題變得困難時仍然持續努力。

en: Writers in some countries face strict censorship, so they cannot publish certain ideas in their books.
exzh: 某些國家的作家面臨嚴格的審查，所以無法在書中發表某些想法。

en: Scientists are still studying the genesis of the universe, hoping to understand how everything began.
exzh: 科學家仍在研究宇宙的起源，希望了解萬物如何開始。

en: The bookstore found its niche by selling only comic books and board games to local teenagers.
exzh: 這間書店只賣漫畫和桌遊給當地青少年，找到了自己的利基市場。

en: Many people find that gardening is therapeutic because it helps them relax after a stressful day.
exzh: 許多人覺得園藝有療癒效果，因為它能幫助人在忙碌的一天後放鬆。

en: Scientists measure atmospheric pressure to help them predict storms and changes in the weather.
exzh: 科學家測量大氣壓力來幫助預測暴風雨與天氣變化。
note: 另有「有氣氛的」意思，如 atmospheric music

en: Our teacher wrote a careful critique of each essay and suggested ways to improve the writing.
exzh: 老師為每篇作文寫了仔細的評析，並建議改進寫作的方法。
note: 比 criticism 更偏重有條理的分析

en: There is a large differential in rainfall between the north and south of the island.
exzh: 這座島的北部與南部降雨量差異很大。

en: The port city served as a gateway for trade between Asia and Europe for hundreds of years.
exzh: 這座港口城市數百年來一直是亞洲與歐洲之間貿易的門戶。

en: The poem uses beautiful imagery of rivers and mountains to describe the writer's homeland.
exzh: 這首詩用河流與山岳的優美意象來描寫作者的家鄉。

en: Two college friends founded a small startup that designs apps to help people learn languages.
exzh: 兩位大學同學創辦了一家設計語言學習應用程式的小型新創公司。

en: The festival is wholly funded by donations from local families and small businesses in the town.
exzh: 這個慶典完全由鎮上家庭和小型商家的捐款支持。

en: File compression makes photos smaller, so they take up less space on your phone.
exzh: 檔案壓縮讓照片變小，所以它們在你的手機上佔用較少空間。

en: My uncle is a computer guru, and everyone in the family asks him for help.
exzh: 我叔叔是電腦大師，家裡每個人都找他幫忙。

en: This online marketplace lets farmers sell fresh fruit directly to families in the city.
exzh: 這個線上市集讓農民把新鮮水果直接賣給城市裡的家庭。

en: The scientists explained their methodology clearly so that other teams could repeat the experiment.
exzh: 科學家清楚說明他們的研究方法，讓其他團隊能重複這個實驗。

en: The local newspaper dubbed the young swimmer the "Pride of the Harbor" after she broke three records.
exzh: 在這位年輕游泳選手打破三項紀錄後，當地報紙稱她為「港灣之光」。
note: input 為 dubbed，改教原形 dub；另一常見義：為外語影片配音（重複，已刪）

en: Doctors warn that too much sugar and too little exercise can lead to obesity in children.
exzh: 醫生警告，過多的糖分與過少的運動可能導致孩童肥胖。

en: Doctors warn that air pollution can cause respiratory problems, especially for young children and older adults.
exzh: 醫生警告，空氣污染可能造成呼吸問題，尤其是對幼童和年長者。

en: The students felt righteous anger when they learned that the river had been polluted on purpose.
exzh: 學生得知河川被蓄意汙染時，心中充滿義憤。

en: The student council made several amendments to the club rules before the final vote took place.
exzh: 學生會在最後投票前，對社團規章做了幾項修正。
note: 動詞 amend；make amendments to 對…做修正

en: After a long week of exams, lying on the beach felt like pure bliss.
exzh: 結束一整週的考試後，躺在沙灘上真是無比幸福。

en: Regular exercise can speed up your metabolism and help your body use energy more efficiently.
exzh: 規律運動可以加快新陳代謝，幫助身體更有效率地使用能量。

en: The class made a funny parody of a famous movie trailer for the school festival.
exzh: 全班為校慶製作了一支模仿知名電影預告片的搞笑作品。

en: In the old story, a phantom was said to walk through the empty hall every midnight.
exzh: 在那則古老的故事裡，據說每到午夜就有幽靈在空蕩的大廳裡走動。
note: 也可作形容詞：phantom pain 幻肢痛

en: The idea of a four-day school week is slowly gaining traction among teachers and parents.
exzh: 每週上課四天的想法正逐漸獲得老師與家長的支持。
note: gain traction 逐漸受到重視；另指輪胎抓地力

en: Researchers found a new variant of the virus and began testing whether the vaccine still worked.
exzh: 研究人員發現這種病毒的新變種，並開始測試疫苗是否仍然有效。

en: The old fortress on the hill protected the harbor town from attacks for hundreds of years.
exzh: 山丘上的古老要塞保護這個港口城鎮免受攻擊長達數百年。

en: She learned to bake bread from her maternal grandmother, who lived in a small village.
exzh: 她向住在小村莊的外婆學會了烤麵包。

en: The retired doctor wrote a memoir about her many years of working in small mountain villages.
exzh: 那位退休的醫生寫了一本回憶錄，記述她多年在山區小村莊工作的經歷。

en: Scientists have mapped the chemical pathway that cells use to turn sunlight into stored energy.
exzh: 科學家已描繪出細胞將陽光轉換為儲存能量所經的化學途徑。

en: Every newborn baby's name must be recorded at the household registry within a certain number of days.
exzh: 每個新生兒的名字都必須在規定天數內登記到戶政機關。

en: At the top of the mountain, travelers could behold a sea of clouds stretching to the horizon.
exzh: 在山頂，旅人可以看見一片雲海延伸到地平線。
note: 古雅或文學用語；過去式 beheld

en: The billionaire gave a large part of his money to build schools in poor areas.
exzh: 那位億萬富翁捐出一大筆錢，在貧困地區興建學校。

en: Adding a small amount of this catalyst makes the chemical reaction happen much faster.
exzh: 加入少量這種催化劑，會讓化學反應快得多。
note: 比喻用法：a catalyst for change

en: Doctors say that staying active and keeping the brain busy may help delay dementia in old age.
exzh: 醫生說，保持活動與讓大腦忙碌，可能有助於延緩老年時的失智症。

en: The storm caused horrific damage to the coastal town, and many homes were left without power.
exzh: 這場風暴對沿海小鎮造成駭人的破壞，許多住家因此停電。

en: The government plans to enact a new law to protect forests from illegal cutting.
exzh: 政府打算制定一項新法律來保護森林免於遭到非法砍伐。
note: 原輸入為 enacted，改教原形（重複，已刪）

en: A forensic scientist carefully examined the old document to find out when it was written.
exzh: 一位鑑識科學家仔細檢驗這份舊文件，以查出它是何時寫成的。

en: The new teacher has excellent credentials, including a master's degree and ten years of experience.
exzh: 這位新老師資歷優秀，包括碩士學位和十年經驗。

en: Teachers learned how to stay calm and help a student who has a seizure during class.
exzh: 老師們學習如何保持冷靜，並幫助在課堂上癲癇發作的學生。

en: The movie has a simple storyline, but the beautiful music makes it worth watching.
exzh: 這部電影的劇情很簡單，但優美的音樂讓它值得一看。

en: The report says poor traffic in the city is a systemic problem, not just a few bad roads.
exzh: 報告指出，這座城市的交通不佳是系統性的問題，不只是幾條路不好。

en: Ice can reduce the pain and inflammation around a sprained ankle after a basketball game.
exzh: 冰敷可以減輕打完籃球後腳踝扭傷處的疼痛和發炎。

en: When hiking in the mountains, safety is paramount, so always check the weather before you leave.
exzh: 在山上健行時，安全至關重要，所以出發前務必查看天氣。

en: He became paranoid about his health and checked his temperature ten times a day.
exzh: 他對自己的健康變得疑神疑鬼，一天量十次體溫。

zh: 代理人；代理；代理伺服器
en: If you cannot attend the meeting, you may send a proxy to vote for you.
exzh: 如果你無法出席會議，可以派代理人替你投票。

en: The museum displays ancient artifacts such as pottery, tools, and jewelry found near the river.
exzh: 博物館展出在河邊發現的古代文物，例如陶器、工具和珠寶。

en: Good friends show empathy by listening carefully and trying to understand how you really feel.
exzh: 好朋友會透過仔細傾聽並試著了解你真正的感受來展現同理心。

en: The school music ensemble practices every Friday afternoon before the spring concert.
exzh: 學校的合奏團在春季音樂會前，每週五下午都會練習。
note: 可指整組表演者或搭配好的整體

en: Doctors can often slow the onset of the disease if it is found early.
exzh: 如果及早發現，醫生通常可以延緩疾病的發作。
note: the onset of 的開端，多用於疾病、季節

en: Many families fled their homeland to escape persecution and started a new life in another country.
exzh: 許多家庭為逃避迫害而離開家園，在另一個國家展開新生活。

en: The movie imagines a future apocalypse caused by a giant asteroid hitting the Earth.
exzh: 這部電影想像了一場由巨大小行星撞擊地球所引發的未來末日。

en: The consolidation of the two small schools saved money and gave students more classes.
exzh: 這兩所小學校的合併省下了經費，也讓學生有更多課程可選。

en: The island has great linguistic diversity, with several different languages spoken in one small village.
exzh: 這座島的語言非常多元，一個小村莊裡就有好幾種不同語言。

en: A recurring dream about falling made her feel tired and nervous every morning.
exzh: 一個反覆出現的墜落夢境讓她每天早上都覺得疲憊又緊張。

en: The teacher gave us a template for the report, so every group could follow the same format.
exzh: 老師給了我們報告的範本，讓每一組都能遵循相同的格式。

en: Learning to play the piano is akin to learning a new language in many ways.
exzh: 學彈鋼琴在許多方面類似於學習一種新語言。

en: Before the training program began, we measured each student's running time as a baseline.
exzh: 訓練計畫開始前，我們先測量每位學生的跑步時間作為基準。

en: The old book is a chronicle of the town's growth from a small village to a busy city.
exzh: 這本古書記載了這個小鎮從小村莊成長為繁忙城市的歷程。

en: The team's creed was simple: work hard, help each other, and never give up.
exzh: 這支隊伍的信條很簡單：努力、互助、永不放棄。

en: A doctor can give you dietary advice to help lower your blood pressure.
exzh: 醫生可以給你飲食方面的建議，幫助降低血壓。

en: I enjoy the hustle and bustle of the night market, with its bright lights, music, and delicious food.
exzh: 我喜歡夜市熙熙攘攘的熱鬧氣氛，有明亮的燈光、音樂和美食。
note: hustle and bustle 熙熙攘攘

en: The storm showed the vulnerability of coastal villages that have no strong walls to block the waves.
exzh: 這場風暴顯示出沒有堅固堤防擋浪的沿海村莊有多脆弱。

en: In the myth, the sea god's wrath sent huge waves that sank the sailors' ships.
exzh: 在神話中，海神的震怒掀起巨浪，讓水手的船隻沉沒。
note: 文學用語，語氣比 anger 強

en: The new citizens promised their allegiance to the country in a short ceremony.
exzh: 新公民在一場簡短的儀式中宣誓對這個國家效忠。
note: pledge allegiance to 向…宣誓效忠

en: Please read the instructions in their entirety before you begin the science experiment.
exzh: 開始科學實驗之前，請完整閱讀所有說明。

en: Every holiday there is a mass exodus from the city as people drive back to their hometowns.
exzh: 每逢假期，人們開車返鄉，城市裡出現大批人潮離去的景象。

zh: 不良後果；餘波；放射性落塵
en: The company faced serious fallout after customers learned that its product had been falsely advertised.
exzh: 顧客得知該產品廣告不實後，公司面臨嚴重的後續風波。

en: Invasive plants from other countries often grow fast and push out local species.
exzh: 來自其他國家的外來入侵植物常常生長迅速，把本地物種擠掉。
note: invasive species 外來入侵種；醫學上指侵入性檢查

zh: 人設；角色形象；公眾形象
en: Online, she created a cheerful persona that was quite different from her quiet real personality.
exzh: 她在網路上塑造了開朗的形象，和她安靜的真實個性相當不同。

en: Some people avoid seeing a counselor because of the stigma attached to talking about mental health.
exzh: 有些人因為談論心理健康所帶來的污名而不願去找諮商師。

en: Scientists tested the efficacy of the new vaccine with thousands of volunteers over several months.
exzh: 科學家以數千名志願者在數個月間測試新疫苗的效力。

en: People with impaired hearing can use special devices to follow what teachers say in class.
exzh: 聽力受損的人可以使用特殊裝置來聽懂老師在課堂上說的話。

zh: 全球大流行病；大流行的
en: During the pandemic, many students learned at home through video classes for several months.
exzh: 疫情大流行期間，許多學生透過視訊課程在家學習了好幾個月。

en: The hospital's procurement team compares prices before buying masks and medical equipment for the winter.
exzh: 醫院的採購團隊在冬天買口罩和醫療設備前會先比價。

en: Our eyes, ears, and skin are sensory organs that send information about the world to the brain.
exzh: 我們的眼睛、耳朵和皮膚是感覺器官，會把外界資訊傳送給大腦。

en: The turnout at the school sports day was high, with almost every parent attending.
exzh: 學校運動會的出席人數很多，幾乎每位家長都來了。

en: In the old story, the young hero seeks vengeance for the loss of his village.
exzh: 在這個古老的故事中，年輕英雄為了失去的村莊尋求復仇。

zh: 行動主義；積極參與社會運動
en: Her environmental activism began when she joined a beach cleanup in junior high school.
exzh: 她的環保行動主義始於國中時參加的一次淨灘活動。

en: The fountain is the focal point of the square, and visitors often gather around it to rest.
exzh: 噴水池是廣場的焦點所在，遊客常聚集在周圍休息。

en: The inaugural meeting of the new science club attracted more than fifty students.
exzh: 新成立的科學社的首次聚會吸引了五十多名學生。

en: Experts warn that malicious software can secretly steal your passwords from a computer.
exzh: 專家警告，惡意軟體可能偷偷竊取你電腦裡的密碼。

en: The restaurant's famous sauce uses a proprietary recipe, so other restaurants cannot legally copy it.
exzh: 這家餐廳的招牌醬汁使用專有配方，所以其他餐廳不能合法仿製。

en: The protagonist of the novel is a shy girl who discovers her talent for music.
exzh: 這本小說的主角是一個害羞的女孩，她發現了自己的音樂天分。

en: The night market is a vibrant place full of music, food, and friendly people.
exzh: 夜市是個充滿活力的地方，到處是音樂、美食與親切的人們。

en: The absorption of water by plant roots is important for the growth of the whole tree.
exzh: 植物根部對水的吸收，對整棵樹的生長很重要。
note: 亦指 absorption in 專注於

en: The company faced a public backlash after it suddenly raised the price of its popular drink.
exzh: 這家公司突然調漲熱門飲料價格後，遭到大眾強烈反彈。

en: The bank asked the owner to use his shop as collateral before it agreed to lend him money.
exzh: 銀行要求店主在同意借錢給他之前，以店面作為擔保品。

en: The concert was a crossover between traditional folk music and modern electronic sounds.
exzh: 這場音樂會是傳統民謠與現代電子音樂的跨界結合。

en: After the long drought, the farmers were in dire need of rain for their crops.
exzh: 經過長期乾旱，農民迫切需要雨水來灌溉作物。

en: In the old story, the king had dominion over all the land between the mountains and the sea.
exzh: 在古老的故事中，國王統治著山與海之間的所有土地。

zh: 周邊的；次要的；周邊設備
en: The printer and mouse are peripheral devices that connect to the main computer.
exzh: 印表機和滑鼠是連接到主機的周邊設備。

en: Researchers are studying the prevalence of short-sightedness among teenagers in big cities.
exzh: 研究人員正在調查大城市青少年近視的盛行率。

en: After days of rain, the soil was saturated and could not hold any more water.
exzh: 連下幾天雨之後，土壤已經飽和，無法再容納更多水分。

en: Volunteers want tangible results, such as a cleaner park, to see that their work really matters.
exzh: 志工希望看到具體成果，例如更乾淨的公園，來證明自己的付出確實有意義。

en: In math class, we learned that the derivative of a function shows how fast it changes.
exzh: 在數學課上，我們學到函數的導數顯示它變化得有多快。
note: 數學上為「導數」；也可指模仿而缺乏原創的

en: Since its inception ten years ago, the club has helped hundreds of students learn to code.
exzh: 自十年前創立以來，這個社團已經幫助數百名學生學會寫程式。
note: since its inception 自創立以來

en: The fire was caused by negligence, because workers forgot to turn off the old machine.
exzh: 這場火災是由疏忽造成的，因為工人忘了關掉那台舊機器。

en: The train station is the nexus of the city, where many bus and subway lines meet.
exzh: 這座火車站是城市的樞紐，許多公車和捷運路線在此交會。

en: Many old phone models became obsolete when newer ones with better cameras appeared on the market.
exzh: 當具有更好相機的新機型上市後，許多舊款手機就被淘汰了。

en: The newspaper printed a funny satire about people who spend too much time on their phones.
exzh: 那份報紙刊登了一篇有趣的諷刺文章，嘲諷花太多時間滑手機的人。

en: The government decided to deport the visitor because he stayed in the country without a valid visa.
exzh: 政府決定將這名旅客驅逐出境，因為他沒有有效簽證卻留在這個國家。

en: Heavy precipitation in the mountains during typhoon season often fills the reservoirs quickly.
exzh: 颱風季節山區的大量降水常讓水庫迅速蓄滿。

en: Travelers with a fever were asked to stay in quarantine for several days at the airport hotel.
exzh: 發燒的旅客被要求在機場旅館隔離數天。

en: A rift between the two neighbors grew after they argued about the fence for years.
exzh: 兩位鄰居為了圍籬爭吵多年，彼此的關係出現了裂痕。

en: Many countries use standardized tests to compare how well students are learning the same subjects.
exzh: 許多國家用標準化測驗來比較學生在相同科目上的學習成果。

en: For decades, the team held supremacy in the league, winning the championship almost every year.
exzh: 數十年來，這支球隊在聯盟中稱霸，幾乎每年都拿下冠軍。

en: The old speaker made the music sound distorted, so we could hardly hear the singer's words.
exzh: 那個舊喇叭讓音樂聽起來失真，所以我們幾乎聽不清歌手唱的歌詞。

en: Some people questioned the legitimacy of the contest because the rules were not clear.
exzh: 有些人質疑這場比賽的正當性，因為規則並不明確。

en: Historians study the temporal order of events to understand how one thing led to another.
exzh: 歷史學家研究事件發生的時間順序，以了解事情如何一步步演變。
note: temporal 與 spatial（空間的）常對照

en: The phone adjusts its screen brightness according to the ambient light in the room.
exzh: 這支手機會依房間周圍的光線調整螢幕亮度。

en: Before building the robot, the team drew a conceptual design to show their main ideas.
exzh: 在製作機器人之前，團隊先畫了一份概念設計圖來呈現主要想法。

en: The demolition of the old stadium will begin next month to make room for a park.
exzh: 舊體育場的拆除工程將在下個月開始，好騰出空間蓋公園。

en: The two neighboring families had a long feud over a small piece of land.
exzh: 這兩個鄰居家族為了一小塊土地長期不和。

en: Below the thin crust of the Earth lies the mantle, a thick layer of hot rock.
exzh: 在地球薄薄的地殼之下是地函，一層厚厚的熱岩石。
note: 地科常用；亦可指責任（assume the mantle）

en: The smell of fresh bread filled him with nostalgia for his grandmother's kitchen long ago.
exzh: 新鮮麵包的香味讓他對很久以前外婆的廚房充滿懷念。

en: The company announced a restructuring plan to move workers into teams that fit their skills.
exzh: 公司宣布了一項重組計畫，要把員工調入符合其專長的團隊。

en: Bad weather, not sabotage, was the reason the train system stopped working that morning.
exzh: 那天早上鐵路系統停擺的原因是惡劣天氣，不是蓄意破壞。

en: Only school-sanctioned events, such as the science fair, may use the gym after classes end.
exzh: 只有經學校核准的活動，例如科展，才可以在放學後使用體育館。
note: sanction 也可作動詞「制裁」，注意一字兩反義

en: When he said "Great weather!" in the pouring rain, we all knew he was speaking with sarcasm.
exzh: 他在傾盆大雨中說「天氣真好！」，我們都知道他是在說反話諷刺。

en: A vile smell came from the old fridge that no one had cleaned for months.
exzh: 一股令人作嘔的臭味從那台幾個月沒人清理的舊冰箱裡傳出來。

en: Even as a child, she had a natural affinity for music and could play songs by ear.
exzh: 她從小就對音樂有天生的親近感，能憑聽覺彈奏歌曲。

en: The film pays homage to old silent movies by using black-and-white images and live piano music.
exzh: 這部電影用黑白畫面和現場鋼琴音樂向老默片致敬。

en: Copying the singer's songs without permission is an infringement of her copyright.
exzh: 未經許可複製這位歌手的歌曲，是侵犯她著作權的行為。

en: From next Monday onwards, the library will stay open until nine every evening.
exzh: 從下週一起，圖書館每天晚上都會開到九點。

en: The discovery caused a paradigm shift, changing the way scientists think about the solar system.
exzh: 這項發現造成典範轉移，改變了科學家對太陽系的看法。

en: The proliferation of cheap smartphones has changed how young people in many countries learn and play.
exzh: 廉價智慧型手機的激增改變了許多國家年輕人學習和玩樂的方式。

en: The town held a quiet ceremony in remembrance of the people who built the old railway.
exzh: 小鎮舉行了一場安靜的儀式，紀念建造那條舊鐵路的人們。

en: After a short stint as a teacher, she decided to become a science writer.
exzh: 在當了一段時間的老師後，她決定成為科學作家。
note: a stint as/in 一段…的任期

en: Engineers calculated the trajectory of the rocket to make sure it would reach the moon.
exzh: 工程師計算火箭的軌道，以確保它能抵達月球。

en: Many fans think that quiet little cafe is the most underrated spot for studying in town.
exzh: 許多人認為那間安靜的小咖啡館是鎮上最被低估的讀書好地方。

en: The school uses last year's test results as a benchmark to measure how much students have improved.
exzh: 學校以去年的考試結果作為基準，來衡量學生進步了多少。

en: In the past, the caste system decided which jobs people could do in some societies.
exzh: 過去在某些社會裡，種姓制度決定了人們可以從事哪些工作。

zh: 大腦的；理智的；偏重思考的
en: Chess is a cerebral game that requires patience, planning, and careful thinking.
exzh: 西洋棋是一種需要耐心、規劃和仔細思考的燒腦遊戲。

en: The documentary used cinematic shots of the mountains that made the audience feel they were there.
exzh: 這部紀錄片用電影般的山景鏡頭，讓觀眾彷彿身歷其境。

en: Plastic waste causes the degradation of the ocean environment and harms many sea animals.
exzh: 塑膠廢棄物導致海洋環境惡化，並傷害許多海洋動物。

en: Please read only the rules that pertain to your own grade level.
exzh: 請只閱讀與你們這個年級有關的規定。
note: 常用 pertain to；pertaining to 與…有關的

en: The prolific writer published more than fifty books during her long career.
exzh: 這位多產的作家在漫長的職業生涯中出版了五十多本書。

en: His sarcastic reply, "Great, another test," made everyone laugh but also showed how tired he was.
exzh: 他挖苦地回了一句「太好了，又要考試」，讓大家笑了，也顯露出他有多累。

en: Some students dislike an authoritarian teacher who never allows anyone to share different ideas in class.
exzh: 有些學生不喜歡從不讓人在課堂上分享不同想法的專斷老師。

en: Check the compatibility of the game with your computer before you buy it.
exzh: 購買這款遊戲之前，先確認它與你的電腦是否相容。

en: Despite winning many awards, the scientist spoke with humility and thanked her whole team.
exzh: 儘管贏得許多獎項，這位科學家仍謙遜地發言，並感謝她的整個團隊。

en: In some countries, the parliament can start an impeachment process against a leader who breaks the law.
exzh: 在某些國家，國會可以對違法的領導人啟動彈劾程序。

en: On the form, you must tick your marital status, such as single or married.
exzh: 在表格上，你必須勾選自己的婚姻狀況，例如未婚或已婚。

en: Food regulators check labels to make sure that companies do not mislead customers.
exzh: 食品監管人員檢查標示，確保公司不會誤導消費者。

en: Rising housing prices have become a major societal problem that affects young families.
exzh: 房價上漲已成為影響年輕家庭的重大社會問題。
note: 與 social 相比更偏社會整體層面

en: Standing in the empty city at dawn felt strange and surreal, like walking inside a dream.
exzh: 黎明時站在空蕩的城市中感覺奇異而超現實，彷彿走進了夢境。

en: The judges upheld the school's decision, and the rule about wearing uniforms stayed the same.
exzh: 法官維持了學校的決定，穿制服的規定因此維持不變。
note: 過去式 upheld；uphold the law 維護法律

en: The snowy mountains made a perfect backdrop for the family photo we took in winter.
exzh: 白雪覆蓋的群山成了我們冬天拍全家福時完美的背景。

en: The panda is the emblem of the wildlife organization and appears on all its posters.
exzh: 貓熊是這個野生動物組織的標誌，出現在它所有的海報上。

en: The small town saw a sudden influx of tourists during the lantern festival each year.
exzh: 每年燈節期間，這個小鎮都會湧入大量遊客。

en: Our teacher acts as a liaison between the students and the visiting company.
exzh: 我們的老師擔任學生與來訪公司之間的聯絡窗口。

en: The artist made a large mosaic from thousands of tiny pieces of colored glass.
exzh: 這位藝術家用數千片小小的彩色玻璃拼成一幅大型馬賽克畫。

en: The villagers showed great resilience and rebuilt their homes soon after the storm passed.
exzh: 村民展現了強大的韌性，在暴風雨過後不久就重建了家園。

en: Fashion trends are always in flux, so what is popular this month may be forgotten next year.
exzh: 流行趨勢總是不斷變動，所以這個月流行的東西明年可能就被遺忘。

en: Changing trains three times with heavy bags was such a hassle for the tired family.
exzh: 帶著沉重的行李轉三次車，對疲憊的一家人來說真是麻煩。

en: The goalkeeper jumped high to intercept the ball before it reached the goal.
exzh: 守門員高高躍起，在球進門前把它攔截下來。

en: Good internet connectivity allows students in remote areas to join online classes.
exzh: 良好的網路連線讓偏遠地區的學生也能參加線上課程。

en: After the long hike, I had a strong craving for a cold glass of watermelon juice.
exzh: 長途健行之後，我非常渴望喝一杯冰涼的西瓜汁。

en: The school invited an eminent scientist to talk about her research on deep-sea life.
exzh: 學校邀請了一位傑出的科學家來談她對深海生物的研究。

en: Encryption protects your messages so that strangers cannot read them on the internet.
exzh: 加密能保護你的訊息，讓陌生人無法在網路上讀取。

en: Factory workers often find repetitive tasks boring, so robots now do much of that work.
exzh: 工廠員工常覺得重複性的工作很無聊，因此現在很多這類工作改由機器人負責。
note: repetitive strain injury 重複性勞損

en: Tech-savvy students can quickly learn how to use new apps without reading any instructions.
exzh: 精通科技的學生不用看說明就能很快學會使用新的應用程式。

en: Before building the new park, the city asked stakeholders, including nearby families and shop owners, for their opinions.
exzh: 在興建新公園之前，市府詢問了包括附近住戶與店家在內的利害關係人的意見。

en: The curator spent six months choosing the paintings for the new museum exhibition.
exzh: 策展人花了六個月為博物館的新展覽挑選畫作。

en: Staying up late every night can be detrimental to your health and your school performance.
exzh: 每晚熬夜可能對你的健康和學業表現有害。

en: The old speaker produced so much distortion that the music sounded unclear and noisy.
exzh: 那台老舊喇叭失真嚴重，讓音樂聽起來模糊又吵雜。

en: The young director's first film began to garner praise from critics around the world.
exzh: 這位年輕導演的第一部電影開始獲得世界各地影評人的讚賞。

en: Hearing impairment makes it hard for some students to follow classes without help.
exzh: 聽力障礙使得有些學生沒有協助就很難跟上課程。

en: According to local lore, the old tree beside the temple is more than a thousand years old.
exzh: 根據當地傳說，廟旁那棵老樹已有一千多年的歷史。

en: The toddler had a complete meltdown in the store when his mother said he could not have the toy.
exzh: 媽媽說不能買那個玩具後，幼兒在店裡徹底崩潰大哭。

en: A fallen tree caused an obstruction on the mountain road, and traffic was stopped for an hour.
exzh: 一棵倒下的樹造成山路阻塞，交通中斷了一個小時。

en: Their trip around the world by bicycle became a two-year odyssey full of surprises.
exzh: 他們騎腳踏車環遊世界，成了一場充滿驚奇、長達兩年的冒險旅程。

en: In the court case, the plaintiff asked the company to pay for the damage to his house.
exzh: 在這起訴訟中，原告要求公司賠償他房屋的損害。

en: Rumors were rampant at school after the teacher announced a surprise change to the exam schedule.
exzh: 老師宣布考試時間突然更動後，學校裡謠言四起。

en: Other scientists tried to replicate the experiment, but they could not get the same result.
exzh: 其他科學家試圖重現這個實驗，但得不到相同的結果。

en: The country raised taxes on imported goods in retaliation for the other side's trade limits.
exzh: 該國提高進口商品的關稅，作為對另一方貿易限制的報復。
note: in retaliation for 作為對…的報復

en: The pilot asked everyone to fasten their seat belts because the plane was entering an area of turbulence.
exzh: 機長請大家繫好安全帶，因為飛機即將進入亂流區。

en: After ten years in business, she moved to academia and became a professor of environmental science.
exzh: 在商界工作十年後，她轉到學術界，成為環境科學教授。

en: The university received accreditation from an official board, so its degrees are recognized abroad.
exzh: 這所大學獲得官方委員會的認證，所以它的學位在國外也受到承認。

en: Admittedly, the test was difficult, but most students still managed to finish on time.
exzh: 誠然，這次考試很難，但大多數學生還是設法準時寫完了。

en: The aforementioned rules apply to all students who join the school trip next month.
exzh: 上述規定適用於所有參加下個月校外旅行的學生。

en: If the question is not clear, you can ask the teacher for clarification before you answer.
exzh: 如果題目不清楚，你可以在作答前請老師說明。

en: The scientists used a covert camera in the forest to record shy animals without scaring them.
exzh: 科學家在森林裡使用隱藏式攝影機，在不驚嚇害羞動物的情況下記錄牠們。

en: The shop has had friendly dealings with local farmers for more than twenty years.
exzh: 這家店與當地農民有二十多年友好的往來。

en: The university offered him a deferred place, so he can start his studies next year.
exzh: 大學給了他延期入學的名額，所以他明年才開始就讀。

en: Education is a key tool for empowerment because it gives people the skills to make their own choices.
exzh: 教育是賦權的關鍵工具，因為它讓人擁有自行做選擇的能力。

en: The match ended in a tie, and the ensuing discussion among fans lasted late into the night.
exzh: 比賽以平手收場，隨後球迷之間的討論持續到深夜。

en: She has a flair for design, and her posters always catch everyone's eye.
exzh: 她很有設計天分，她做的海報總是吸引每個人的目光。
note: a flair for 對…有天分

en: The school was lax about the rules, so students who arrived late were never punished.
exzh: 這所學校對規定很鬆散，所以遲到的學生從來沒有受罰。

en: Planting trees along the road can help mitigate the effects of noise and heat on nearby homes.
exzh: 沿路種樹有助於減輕噪音和高溫對附近住家的影響。

en: The little coffee shop rose to prominence after a popular travel blog wrote about it.
exzh: 這家小咖啡店在一篇熱門旅遊部落格介紹後聲名鵲起。
note: rise to prominence 嶄露頭角

en: A runaway truck rolled down the hill, but luckily it stopped before reaching the town.
exzh: 一輛失控的卡車沿著山坡滑下，所幸在抵達小鎮前就停住了。
note: 亦可作名詞，指離家出走者

en: The photo of the sea monster turned out to be a hoax made with simple tools.
exzh: 那張水怪的照片結果是用簡單工具做出來的騙局。

en: The quirky little shop sells everything from handmade soap to old maps and strange clocks.
exzh: 這間古怪有趣的小店什麼都賣，從手工肥皂到舊地圖和奇特的時鐘都有。

en: The teacher explained the rationale behind the new schedule so that students could understand it.
exzh: 老師解釋了新課表背後的理由，好讓學生能夠理解。

en: Wash the vegetables well to remove any chemical residue left on their skin.
exzh: 把蔬菜洗乾淨，去除表皮上殘留的化學物質。

zh: 協力；同時進行；雙人協力車
en: The two teams worked in tandem, one collecting data while the other wrote the report.
exzh: 兩個小組協同合作，一組蒐集資料，另一組撰寫報告。
note: in tandem 協力、同時；也指雙人腳踏車

en: The school's robotics club is in the vanguard of technology education in the city.
exzh: 這所學校的機器人社在全市科技教育中走在最前面。
note: in the vanguard of 表「居領先地位」

en: The invention of the printing press was a watershed in the history of learning.
exzh: 印刷術的發明是學習史上的一個重大轉折點。

en: When the power went out, the crowded station fell into anarchy for a few minutes.
exzh: 停電時，擠滿人的車站陷入了幾分鐘的混亂。

en: The old library had a quiet aura that made everyone lower their voices.
exzh: 這座老圖書館有一種安靜的氛圍，讓每個人都不自覺地放低音量。

zh: 雙語的；會說兩種語言的
en: Growing up in a bilingual family, she can switch easily between Mandarin and English.
exzh: 她在雙語家庭中長大，能輕鬆地在中文和英文間切換。

en: Too much dependency on phones can make it harder for teenagers to focus on their studies.
exzh: 過度依賴手機會讓青少年更難專心在課業上。

en: Doctors found a dysfunction in his heart and suggested a small operation.
exzh: 醫生發現他的心臟有功能失常的情形，建議動個小手術。

en: The island is famous for its unique fauna, including birds that live nowhere else.
exzh: 這座島以獨特的動物群聞名，包括世界上其他地方沒有的鳥類。

en: Walking or riding a bike to school can reduce your carbon footprint every single day.
exzh: 走路或騎腳踏車上學可以每天降低你的碳足跡。

en: The lab is at the forefront of research on clean energy and new kinds of batteries.
exzh: 這間實驗室處於清潔能源與新型電池研究的最前沿。
note: at the forefront of 在……的最前線

en: The long drought has put the farmers' entire harvest in jeopardy this year.
exzh: 長期乾旱使農民今年的整個收成陷入危險。
note: in jeopardy 處於危險中；動詞 jeopardize

en: The restaurant looked fancy, but the food was mediocre and the service was slow.
exzh: 這家餐廳看起來很高級，但食物普通，服務也很慢。

en: Some people think that expensive restaurant is overrated because the food is good but not special.
exzh: 有些人認為那家昂貴的餐廳被高估了，因為食物不錯但並不特別。

en: Volunteers brought food and clean water to the flood-stricken villages near the river.
exzh: 志願者把食物和乾淨的水送到河邊遭洪水侵襲的村莊。

en: Schools should care about students' wellbeing as much as their test scores.
exzh: 學校應該像在乎學生成績一樣在乎他們的身心健康。

en: The new station has better accessibility, with elevators and wide doors for wheelchair users.
exzh: 新車站的無障礙設施更完善，有電梯和供輪椅使用者通行的寬門。

en: The doctor said the lump was benign, so there was no need for the family to worry.
exzh: 醫生說那顆腫塊是良性的，所以家人不必擔心。

en: Education can empower young people to make their own choices and build a better future.
exzh: 教育能讓年輕人有能力做出自己的選擇，並打造更美好的未來。

en: The reporter lost his job after writing a fabricated story that was not based on facts.
exzh: 那名記者因為寫了一則不是根據事實的捏造報導而丟了工作。

en: Archaeologists found remnants of an ancient wall under the busy street.
exzh: 考古學家在繁忙的街道底下發現了一道古老城牆的殘跡。

en: Before sharing news online, check whether the source is trustworthy and has been accurate in the past.
exzh: 在網路上分享新聞之前，先確認來源是否值得信賴，過去是否正確。

en: He used a website to learn more about his family's ancestry and where they came from.
exzh: 他利用一個網站，進一步了解自己家族的祖先與來歷。

en: Augmented reality apps let you see digital animals appear on your real desk.
exzh: 擴增實境的應用程式讓你看到數位動物出現在你真實的書桌上。

en: My uncle is an avid reader who finishes at least two books every week.
exzh: 我叔叔是個熱愛閱讀的人，每週至少讀完兩本書。

en: The study found that hours of sleep are closely correlated with students' test scores.
exzh: 研究發現睡眠時數與學生的考試成績有密切關聯。

en: Common decency tells us to give our seats to elderly people on the crowded bus.
exzh: 基本的禮貌讓我們在擁擠的公車上把座位讓給長者。

en: The seeds are dispersed by the wind and fall far from the parent plant.
exzh: 種子被風吹散，落在離母株很遠的地方。
note: 動詞 disperse；此處為過去分詞作被動

zh: 登上；著手；開始（旅程或事業）
en: After finishing school, she plans to embark on a long journey around the world.
exzh: 完成學業後，她打算展開一趟環遊世界的長途旅行。
note: embark on / upon 開始從事；原字形 embarked 改為原形 embark（重複，已刪）

en: The sudden storm wreaked havoc on the outdoor concert, and thousands of people had to run for shelter.
exzh: 突如其來的暴風雨讓戶外演唱會陷入大混亂，數千人得跑去避雨。

en: No honest company would knowingly sell food that could make its customers sick.
exzh: 沒有一家誠實的公司會明知故犯地販賣可能讓顧客生病的食物。

en: "Keep trying" is the mantra of our coach, and the team repeats it before every game.
exzh: 「持續嘗試」是我們教練的口頭禪，球隊每場比賽前都會一起複誦。

en: Drivers are obligated to stop when the traffic light turns red.
exzh: 當紅燈亮起時，駕駛人有義務停車。
note: be obligated to V；名詞 obligation

en: When the cafe could not sell enough coffee, the owner decided to pivot to selling lunch boxes.
exzh: 咖啡館咖啡賣不夠多時，老闆決定轉型賣便當。

zh: 有韌性的；能迅速恢復的
en: Young trees are surprisingly resilient and can grow back quickly after a strong storm.
exzh: 幼樹出乎意料地有韌性，在強烈風暴後能很快重新生長。

en: Some mushrooms contain toxins that can make you very sick if you eat them.
exzh: 有些蕈類含有毒素，吃了會讓人病得很嚴重。

en: The price of the house was astronomical, so most young families could not afford it.
exzh: 那棟房子的價格是天文數字，大多數年輕家庭都買不起。
note: 兩義：天文的／（數字）極大的

en: Two concurrent events, a science fair and a music show, made it hard to choose where to go.
exzh: 科學展和音樂表演同時舉行，讓人很難決定要去哪一場。

zh: 預期；期望（life expectancy 平均壽命）
en: Thanks to better medicine, the average life expectancy in many countries has risen over the past century.
exzh: 由於醫藥進步，過去一個世紀許多國家的平均壽命都提高了。

en: The grassroots movement began when a few neighbors cleaned up the beach together.
exzh: 這個草根運動起源於幾位鄰居一起清理海灘。
note: 亦可作名詞，指基層民眾

en: Some kinds of heart disease are hereditary, so doctors ask about your family history.
exzh: 某些心臟疾病會遺傳，所以醫生會詢問你的家族病史。

en: The sky turned a warm orange hue as the sun slowly went down behind the mountains.
exzh: 太陽慢慢落到山後時，天空染上一層溫暖的橘色調。

en: A short lapse in attention while driving can lead to a serious accident.
exzh: 開車時短暫的分神失誤可能導致嚴重的意外。
note: also: lapse of time 時間的流逝

en: The night sky shows myriad stars when you are far away from the city lights.
exzh: 遠離城市燈光時，夜空會呈現出無數顆星星。
note: 亦可作名詞 a myriad of

en: The team's quick progress this semester is noteworthy and deserves special praise.
exzh: 這個團隊這學期的快速進步值得注意，也值得特別讚賞。

en: She took a pragmatic approach to studying and focused on the topics that appear most often on exams.
exzh: 她以務實的方式讀書，專注在最常出現在考試中的主題。

en: The city revoked the shop's license after it failed several health inspections in a row.
exzh: 這家店連續多次衛生檢查不合格後，市府吊銷了它的執照。

en: Pilots practice in a simulated cockpit before they fly a real airplane.
exzh: 飛行員在駕駛真正的飛機前，先在模擬駕駛艙裡練習。

zh: 賣座鉅片；轟動一時的事物
en: The summer blockbuster attracted millions of viewers and earned a huge amount of money.
exzh: 這部暑假賣座鉅片吸引了數百萬名觀眾，賺進了巨額收入。

zh: 有魅力的；有領袖氣質的
en: The charismatic coach inspired the whole team with his energy and his confidence in every player.
exzh: 這位有魅力的教練以他的活力和對每位球員的信心鼓舞了整支隊伍。

en: The teacher confiscated the student's phone because he was playing a game during the exam.
exzh: 老師沒收了那位學生的手機，因為他在考試時玩遊戲。

zh: 十字路口；重要的轉捩點
en: At the crossroads, turn left and walk for five minutes to reach the temple.
exzh: 到了十字路口向左轉，再走五分鐘就會到那座廟。
note: at a crossroads 處於重大抉擇之際

en: In the experiment, half of the patients took the real medicine and half took a placebo.
exzh: 在這項實驗中，一半的病人服用真正的藥，另一半服用安慰劑。

en: The injury was aggravated by running too soon, so the player had to rest for another month.
exzh: 這個傷勢因太早跑步而惡化，所以球員必須再多休息一個月。

en: Scientists noticed an anomaly in the data and decided to repeat the measurement carefully.
exzh: 科學家注意到資料中的異常現象，於是決定仔細重新測量。

en: Coral reefs have rich biodiversity, and thousands of species of fish live among them.
exzh: 珊瑚礁擁有豐富的生物多樣性，數千種魚類生活其間。

en: Water fell in a beautiful cascade down the rocks and into the clear pool below.
exzh: 水像美麗的小瀑布般沿著岩石流下，注入底下清澈的水池。

en: A centralized system stores all the school's records in one place, which makes them easy to find.
exzh: 集中式系統把學校所有紀錄存放在同一處，讓資料很容易查找。

en: After the long hike, we all began to crave a cold drink and a warm meal.
exzh: 長途健行之後，我們都開始渴望一杯冷飲和一頓熱騰騰的飯菜。
note: 多指強烈想吃或想要：crave sweets

en: Teachers and parents joined together to denounce cheating in the national exam.
exzh: 老師與家長一同公開譴責全國考試中的作弊行為。

en: The juice was too sweet, so she added water and drank the diluted drink.
exzh: 果汁太甜，所以她加了水，喝稀釋過的飲料。

zh: 難以捉摸的；難以找到的
en: The snow leopard is so elusive that even experienced researchers rarely see one in the wild.
exzh: 雪豹十分難以捉摸，連經驗豐富的研究人員也很少在野外見到。

en: Rising sea levels pose an existential threat to some small island countries in the Pacific.
exzh: 海平面上升對太平洋上一些小島國構成攸關存亡的威脅。

en: Large fluctuations in temperature can harm young plants in the early spring.
exzh: 氣溫的大幅波動可能會傷害早春的幼苗。

en: My little brother gets grumpy when he is hungry or has not had enough sleep.
exzh: 我弟弟餓了或睡眠不足時就會鬧脾氣。

en: Some online scams appear in the guise of a free gift, but they only want your personal data.
exzh: 有些網路詐騙以免費贈品的名義出現，其實只是想要你的個資。
note: 常搭配 in the guise of

en: Living abroad for a year is a great way to learn through full language immersion.
exzh: 在國外生活一年是透過完全的語言沉浸來學習語言的好方法。
note: language immersion 語言沉浸式學習

zh: 降級；貶到較不重要的地位
en: The team lost so many games that it was relegated to a lower league.
exzh: 這支球隊輸了太多場比賽，被降到較低的聯賽。
note: 常用被動 be relegated to

en: The new software will unleash the power of the computer and let you edit videos faster.
exzh: 這套新軟體將釋放電腦的效能，讓你更快剪輯影片。
note: 另有「突然引發」之意，如 unleash a storm

en: The convergence of phones, cameras, and music players into one device changed daily life.
exzh: 手機、相機和音樂播放器匯聚成一個裝置，改變了日常生活。

zh: 歧視性的；不公平對待的
en: The school changed its discriminatory rule so that all students could join the sports team.
exzh: 學校修改了帶有歧視的規定，讓所有學生都能加入運動校隊。

en: The old fence was forcibly removed to make space for the new bicycle path.
exzh: 舊圍籬被強行拆除，好為新的自行車道騰出空間。
note: 形容詞 forcible；比 by force 更書面
