en: Globalization has made it easy for people to buy products made in other countries.
exzh: 全球化讓人們很容易就能買到其他國家製造的產品。

en: The scientist won a prize for her groundbreaking research on how plants communicate with each other.
exzh: 這位科學家因其關於植物如何彼此溝通的開創性研究而獲獎。

en: Scientists believe that air pollution is implicated in the rise of breathing problems in big cities.
exzh: 科學家認為空氣污染與大城市呼吸道問題增加有關。
note: 常用被動：be implicated in 與…有關

en: She is proud of her family lineage, which goes back more than ten generations.
exzh: 她為自己的家族世系感到驕傲，那可以追溯到十幾代以前。

en: From that day onward, the students met every Friday to practice English together.
exzh: 從那天起，學生們每週五都會聚在一起練習英文。

en: Please do not smear butter on the paper, or the whole page will be oily and hard to read.
exzh: 請不要把奶油塗在紙上，否則整頁會油膩膩的很難讀。

en: A short note will suffice, so you do not need to write a long letter.
exzh: 一張簡短的字條就夠了，所以你不需要寫一封長信。
note: Suffice it to say 簡單說

en: The team made an astounding recovery and won the game after being far behind.
exzh: 這支球隊做出令人震驚的逆轉，在大幅落後後贏得了比賽。

en: The referee ignored a blatant foul, and the fans were upset about the final result.
exzh: 裁判無視一個明目張膽的犯規，球迷對最終結果很不滿。

en: The new bike lane has been a boon for students who ride to school every day.
exzh: 新的自行車道對每天騎車上學的學生來說是一大福音。

en: The coach gave the players a candid talk about what they needed to improve before the final.
exzh: 教練對球員們坦率地談了決賽前他們需要改進的地方。

en: The teacher decided to entrust the class garden to two responsible students.
exzh: 老師決定把班上的菜園託付給兩位負責任的學生。
note: entrust A to B / entrust B with A

en: Thanks to the new safety rules, traffic fatalities on this road dropped sharply last year.
exzh: 由於新的安全規定，這條道路去年的交通死亡人數大幅下降。

en: The festivities in the town square include music, dancing, food stands, and a parade of lanterns.
exzh: 鎮上廣場的慶祝活動包括音樂、舞蹈、小吃攤和燈籠遊行。

en: A small glitch in the software made the online exam page freeze for a few minutes.
exzh: 軟體的一個小故障讓線上考試頁面當機了好幾分鐘。

en: There was mayhem in the hallway when the fire alarm rang during the break.
exzh: 下課時火災警報響起，走廊上一片混亂。

en: Looking at old photos made my grandmother feel nostalgic about her childhood in the countryside.
exzh: 看著老照片，我的外婆對她在鄉下的童年感到懷念。
note: be nostalgic for / about；名詞 nostalgia

en: Winning the national championship was the pinnacle of the swimmer's career after years of hard training.
exzh: 多年辛苦訓練後，贏得全國冠軍是這位游泳選手職業生涯的巔峰。

en: The so-called prize was a sham, and the people who joined the contest received nothing.
exzh: 所謂的獎品是一場騙局，參加比賽的人什麼也沒拿到。

en: There is a large variance in test scores between the two classes this semester.
exzh: 本學期兩個班級的考試成績差異很大。

en: The teacher reduced our homework workload so we could rest before the big exam.
exzh: 老師減少了我們的作業量，讓我們在大考前能夠休息。
note: heavy workload 繁重的工作量

en: The school has a contingency plan in case a typhoon forces classes to be canceled.
exzh: 學校有一套應變計畫，以防颱風迫使停課。

en: She curated an exhibition of old photographs that showed how the city has changed over time.
exzh: 她策劃了一場老照片展，呈現這座城市隨時間的變遷。

en: He duly handed in his report on Friday, just as the teacher had asked.
exzh: 他依照老師的要求，在週五準時交了報告。

en: A shopping frenzy filled the mall on the first day of the big sale.
exzh: 大特價的第一天，購物狂潮擠滿了整間商場。
note: in a frenzy 陷入狂熱

en: I inadvertently deleted the file while cleaning my desktop, so I had to write the report again.
exzh: 我清理桌面時不小心刪掉了檔案，所以得重寫報告。

en: After winning ten games in a row, the team began to feel almost invincible.
exzh: 連贏十場比賽後，這支球隊開始覺得自己幾乎所向無敵。

en: The bicycle was a precursor of the modern motorcycle and changed how people traveled.
exzh: 腳踏車是現代機車的前身，改變了人們的出行方式。

en: Proponents of the new bike lane say it will make the city cleaner and safer.
exzh: 新自行車道的支持者表示，它會讓城市更乾淨、更安全。

en: After the earthquake, rescue workers searched through the rubble for anyone who might still be alive.
exzh: 地震後，救難人員在瓦礫堆中搜尋可能仍然活著的人。

en: Engineers studied the viability of building a solar power station on the small island.
exzh: 工程師研究了在這座小島上興建太陽能發電站的可行性。

en: Every spring, the family returns to its ancestral home in the mountains to clean the graves.
exzh: 每年春天，這家人都會回到山裡的祖厝去掃墓。

en: The movie shows an apocalyptic future in which the Earth is covered by dust.
exzh: 這部電影呈現了一個地球被塵土覆蓋的末日未來。

en: The email offering a free vacation was bogus, so the teacher told us to delete it.
exzh: 那封提供免費度假的電子郵件是假的，所以老師叫我們刪掉它。

en: We were stuck in horrendous traffic for three hours and missed the beginning of the concert.
exzh: 我們被困在糟透了的車陣中三個小時，錯過了音樂會的開頭。

en: Even mundane tasks like washing dishes can feel relaxing when you listen to music.
exzh: 即使是洗碗這類平凡的家事，聽著音樂做也會覺得放鬆。

en: The committee gave its official sanction to the plan to build a new school playground.
exzh: 委員會正式批准了興建新校園遊樂場的計畫。
note: 兩義相反：批准／制裁，視上下文

en: The country has stringent rules about food safety, so every restaurant is checked several times a year.
exzh: 這個國家對食品安全有嚴格的規定，所以每家餐廳一年都會被檢查好幾次。

en: Education is one of the best ways to fight bigotry and help people respect each other.
exzh: 教育是對抗偏見、幫助人們彼此尊重的最佳方式之一。

en: All the buildings in the area must be compliant with the new fire safety rules.
exzh: 這個地區所有的建築都必須符合新的消防安全規定。
note: compliant with 符合；名詞 compliance

en: Colors form a continuum, with each shade slowly changing into the next one.
exzh: 顏色形成一個連續體，每一種色調都慢慢變成下一種。

en: On this map, a red dot denotes a hospital and a blue square denotes a school.
exzh: 在這張地圖上，紅點表示醫院，藍色方塊表示學校。

en: The desert looked devoid of life, yet many small animals were hiding under the sand.
exzh: 沙漠看起來毫無生命跡象，但許多小動物其實躲在沙子底下。

en: There is still a big disparity in internet access between cities and remote villages.
exzh: 城市與偏遠村莊之間在網路使用上仍有很大的差距。

en: The old theater has a beautiful stone facade that attracts many tourists.
exzh: 這座老劇院有一面美麗的石造外牆，吸引了許多遊客。
note: 亦可寫 façade；比喻『虛假的外表』

en: A thick haze covered the city this morning, making it hard to see the tall buildings.
exzh: 今天早上濃濃的霧霾籠罩城市，讓人很難看清高樓。

en: For many villagers near the coast, fishing is their main livelihood.
exzh: 對許多海邊的村民來說，捕魚是他們主要的生計。

en: Buying expensive tools for a simple project was a misguided decision.
exzh: 為了一個簡單的專題買昂貴的工具是個錯誤的決定。

en: His paranoia about being watched made it hard for him to relax at work.
exzh: 他總覺得被人監視的多疑心理，讓他在工作時很難放鬆。

en: In history class, we read about groups that were persecuted for their beliefs and forced to leave.
exzh: 在歷史課上，我們讀到一些因信仰而受迫害並被迫離開的族群。

en: Psychologists study how childhood experiences can shape the human psyche for many years.
exzh: 心理學家研究童年經驗如何在多年之間塑造人的心靈。

en: Smartphones are now ubiquitous, and you can see people using them everywhere you go.
exzh: 智慧型手機如今無所不在，不管你到哪裡都看得到有人在用。

en: The visionary mayor planned a green city with more parks and clean public transport.
exzh: 這位有遠見的市長規劃了一座擁有更多公園和乾淨大眾運輸的綠色城市。

en: The agile cat jumped from the shelf to the window without knocking over a single cup.
exzh: 那隻敏捷的貓從架子跳到窗邊，連一個杯子都沒碰倒。

en: During the years of austerity, the city cut spending and delayed many building projects.
exzh: 在緊縮的那幾年，市府削減開支，並延後許多建設計畫。

en: The school was constrained by a small budget and could not build the new gym.
exzh: 學校受限於預算很少，無法興建新的體育館。
note: 動詞 constrain；constrained by 受…限制

zh: 休眠的；潛伏的；暫停活動的
en: The volcano has been dormant for centuries, but scientists still watch it carefully.
exzh: 這座火山已經休眠了幾個世紀，但科學家仍然仔細監測它。

en: Many young players try to emulate the famous athlete by practicing every morning before school.
exzh: 許多年輕球員努力效法那位著名運動員，每天上學前都練習。

en: The science course encompasses physics, chemistry, and biology, so students learn many different topics.
exzh: 這門自然課程涵蓋物理、化學和生物，所以學生學到許多不同的主題。
note: encompass 為及物動詞，不加介系詞

en: The island is richly endowed with beautiful beaches and clear blue water.
exzh: 這座島嶼天然擁有美麗的海灘與清澈的藍色海水。

en: Rising rents led to the eviction of several families from the old apartment building.
exzh: 租金上漲導致幾個家庭被迫搬離這棟老公寓。

en: She was so immersed in her novel that she did not hear the bell ring.
exzh: 她太沉浸在小說裡，連鐘聲響了都沒聽到。

zh: 主動積極的；事前採取行動的
en: Be proactive about your health by eating well and exercising before problems begin.
exzh: 要主動照顧自己的健康，在問題發生前就好好吃飯和運動。

en: It is prudent to save some money each month for unexpected costs.
exzh: 每個月存一些錢以備意外開銷是明智的做法。

en: You should buy medicine only from a reputable pharmacy that has a valid license.
exzh: 你應該只向持有有效執照、信譽良好的藥局購買藥品。

en: The meeting ended without any substantive decisions, so the committee will meet again next week.
exzh: 會議結束時沒有任何實質決定，所以委員會下週會再開會。

en: The museum arranged the tools in chronological order, from the oldest to the newest.
exzh: 博物館依時間順序排列這些工具，從最古老的到最新的。
note: in chronological order 依時間順序

en: The first cohort of students in the new program graduated with excellent results.
exzh: 這個新課程的第一屆學生以優異的成績畢業。
note: 研究中指同一時期的一群受試者

en: After many tests, the engineers found the culprit behind the power failure was a broken wire.
exzh: 經過多次測試，工程師發現停電的元凶是一條斷掉的電線。
note: 亦可指造成問題的原因

zh: 令人卻步的；令人畏懼的
en: Writing a long research report can seem daunting at first, but it gets easier step by step.
exzh: 寫一份很長的研究報告起初可能令人卻步，但一步步來就會變得容易。

en: Any deviation from the plan should be reported to the team leader right away.
exzh: 任何偏離計畫的情形都應該立刻向組長報告。

en: The diffusion of the smell of fresh bread filled the whole kitchen within minutes.
exzh: 新鮮麵包的香味在幾分鐘內擴散，瀰漫了整個廚房。

zh: 創業的；有企業家精神的
en: Our school offers an entrepreneurial course that teaches students how to start a small business.
exzh: 我們學校開設創業課程，教學生如何創立小型事業。

en: Good table etiquette includes waiting for everyone to be served before you start eating.
exzh: 良好的餐桌禮儀包括等大家的餐點都上了才開始吃。

en: The students wrote heartfelt thank-you cards to the bus driver who had helped them for years.
exzh: 學生們寫了由衷的感謝卡片，給多年來一直幫助他們的公車司機。

en: The storm caused only localized flooding, and most of the city stayed dry.
exzh: 這場暴風雨只造成局部淹水，城市大部分地區都沒有積水。
note: 亦可指在地化，如 localized software

en: The artist used a flower motif on every plate, cup, and bowl in the set.
exzh: 藝術家在這套組的每個盤子、杯子和碗上都用了花朵圖案。
note: 亦指文學、音樂中反覆出現的主題

en: As a newcomer to the school, he was nervous, but his classmates quickly helped him feel welcome.
exzh: 身為學校的新來者，他很緊張，但同學很快就讓他感到受歡迎。

en: Dark, ominous clouds gathered over the field, and the referee stopped the game.
exzh: 烏黑不祥的雲層聚集在球場上方，裁判便暫停了比賽。

en: Years of strife between the two villages ended when they finally shared the river fairly.
exzh: 兩個村莊多年的紛爭，在他們終於公平分享河水時畫下了句點。

en: Online anonymity lets people speak freely, but it can also encourage rude comments.
exzh: 網路匿名讓人們暢所欲言，但也可能助長無禮的留言。

en: The teacher was amazed by the brilliance of the student's solution to the difficult math problem.
exzh: 老師對這位學生解決那道困難數學題的才華感到驚訝。

en: Honesty is the cornerstone of any good friendship, and trust grows from it.
exzh: 誠實是任何良好友誼的基石，信任由此而生。

en: The thief tried to evade the guards by hiding behind a large truck.
exzh: 小偷試圖躲在一輛大卡車後面來躲避警衛。
note: evade taxes 逃稅；名詞 evasion

en: It was futile to chase the bus, because it had already turned the corner.
exzh: 追公車是徒勞的，因為它已經轉過街角了。

en: The workers wrote a letter listing their grievances about long hours and low pay.
exzh: 工人們寫了一封信，列出他們對工時過長和薪水過低的不滿。

en: Smartphones have become so pervasive that people use them everywhere, from buses to classrooms.
exzh: 智慧型手機已經如此普及，從公車到教室，人們隨處都在使用。

en: Predatory birds like eagles have sharp eyes that can spot small animals from far away.
exzh: 像老鷹這類的猛禽有銳利的眼睛，能從很遠的地方發現小動物。

en: Some people think punitive fines are less useful than teaching drivers about road safety.
exzh: 有些人認為懲罰性罰款不如教導駕駛人道路安全來得有用。

en: Cutting down too many trees can have serious repercussions for the animals and people living nearby.
exzh: 砍伐太多樹木可能對附近的動物和居民造成嚴重的後果。

en: Running long distances builds stamina, so you will feel less tired during the school sports day.
exzh: 長跑能培養耐力，所以你在學校運動會時就不會那麼容易累。

en: No one has ever built a perfect utopia where everyone is always happy.
exzh: 從來沒有人建立過每個人永遠快樂的完美烏托邦。

en: The university will confer honorary degrees on three scientists at the ceremony next month.
exzh: 大學將在下個月的典禮上授予三位科學家榮譽學位。
note: confer sth. on sb.；亦指 confer with sb. 與某人商議

en: The two groups held divergent views on whether the school should start classes later in the morning.
exzh: 兩組人對學校是否該把早上上課時間延後，持有分歧的看法。

en: Her exemplary behavior in class made her a good role model for younger students.
exzh: 她在課堂上的模範行為，使她成為學弟妹的好榜樣。

en: From the top of the hill, we enjoyed an expansive view of the green valley.
exzh: 從山頂上，我們欣賞到綠色山谷的遼闊景色。

en: The company chose incremental changes instead of one big change, so workers could adjust slowly.
exzh: 公司選擇漸進式的調整而非一次大改變，讓員工能慢慢適應。

en: The obnoxious man on the train talked loudly on the phone and ignored everyone's annoyed looks.
exzh: 火車上那個討人厭的男人大聲講電話，無視大家不悅的眼神。

en: In the old legend, the king feared divine retribution for breaking his promise to the villagers.
exzh: 在古老的傳說中，國王害怕因違背對村民的承諾而遭到天譴。

en: The tainted water made many villagers sick, so the town sent in clean bottles.
exzh: 受污染的水讓許多村民生病，所以鎮公所送來了乾淨的瓶裝水。

en: The variability of the weather in spring makes it difficult to plan outdoor activities.
exzh: 春天天氣的多變讓戶外活動很難規劃。

en: The affluent neighborhood has large houses, wide streets, and several private tennis courts.
exzh: 那個富裕的社區有大房子、寬闊的街道和好幾座私人網球場。

en: The family felt deep anguish while they waited for news about their missing pet.
exzh: 在等待走失寵物的消息時，這家人感到十分焦急痛苦。

en: Few plants can survive in the arid land where it rarely rains.
exzh: 在很少下雨的乾旱土地上，只有少數植物能生存。

en: Workers spent ten years building the colossal bridge that now links the two islands.
exzh: 工人花了十年建造這座連結兩座島的龐大橋梁。
note: 與 huge 同義，語氣更強

en: The soup was decidedly too salty, so we added more water and a few vegetables.
exzh: 那碗湯明顯太鹹了，所以我們加了更多水和一些蔬菜。

en: He lived under the delusion that he could pass the exam without studying at all.
exzh: 他抱著一種錯覺，以為自己完全不念書也能通過考試。

en: Her music taste is eclectic, from old folk songs to modern dance music.
exzh: 她的音樂品味兼容並蓄，從古老的民謠到現代舞曲都聽。

zh: 地方特有的；某地盛行的
en: This small frog is endemic to Taiwan and cannot be found in any other country.
exzh: 這種小型青蛙是台灣特有種，在其他國家都找不到。
note: be endemic to；台灣特有種 endemic species

en: Becoming a doctor entails many years of study and a great deal of patience and hard work.
exzh: 成為醫生需要多年的學習，以及大量的耐心和努力。

en: Clear explanations are the hallmark of a good teacher, and students always appreciate them.
exzh: 清楚的講解是好老師的特色，學生總是很感激。

zh: 一塵不染的；完美無瑕的
en: The hotel room was immaculate, with fresh sheets and a spotless floor.
exzh: 那間旅館房間一塵不染，床單潔淨，地板也乾乾淨淨。

en: When the power went out, we held an improvised concert using only guitars and voices.
exzh: 停電時，我們只靠吉他和歌聲辦了一場即興音樂會。

en: The average lifespan of a house cat is around fifteen years if it is well cared for.
exzh: 被好好照顧的家貓，平均壽命大約是十五年。

en: We stayed in a rustic cabin by the lake, with wooden furniture and no television.
exzh: 我們住在湖邊一間質樸的小木屋，裡面有木製家具，沒有電視。

en: The room had subdued lighting that helped everyone feel calm and relaxed.
exzh: 這個房間的燈光柔和，讓每個人都覺得平靜放鬆。
note: 亦可指情緒低落、不熱絡

en: The teacher began the lesson with a funny anecdote about his first day at school.
exzh: 老師以一則關於他上學第一天的趣聞展開這堂課。

en: Words like "thou" sound archaic today and are mostly found in old plays and poems.
exzh: 像 thou 這樣的字今天聽起來很古老，大多出現在老戲劇和詩裡。

en: The students were baffled by the strange puzzle and could not find the answer for an hour.
exzh: 學生們被這個奇怪的謎題難倒了，一個小時都找不到答案。

en: Some websites censor comments that contain rude words before other users can see them.
exzh: 有些網站會在其他使用者看到之前，審查並刪除含有粗話的留言。
note: 名詞指審查員；名詞 censorship

en: The students asked for a more equitable way to share the limited number of laptops.
exzh: 學生要求以更公平的方式分配數量有限的筆記型電腦。
note: 與 equal 不同，強調依需求而公平

en: She had to pay a hefty fine for returning the library book three months late.
exzh: 她因為晚了三個月還圖書館的書，得付一大筆罰款。

en: The magazine publishes satirical cartoons that make fun of everyday problems in a clever way.
exzh: 這本雜誌刊登諷刺漫畫，以巧妙的方式嘲弄日常生活中的問題。

en: Plants are sparse in the desert, so animals must travel far to find food.
exzh: 沙漠裡植物稀疏，所以動物必須長途跋涉才能找到食物。

en: The shop will withhold payment until the customer confirms that the package has arrived.
exzh: 店家會暫不付款，直到顧客確認包裹已經送達。
note: 過去式 withheld；原字形 withheld 改為原形 withhold（重複，已刪）

en: The dog became agitated when it heard the loud thunder and ran under the bed.
exzh: 那隻狗聽到響亮的雷聲就變得焦躁不安，跑到床下去躲。

en: Without more evidence, the idea that the lake once dried up is only conjecture.
exzh: 在沒有更多證據之前，這個湖泊曾經乾涸的說法只是推測。

en: The dance became a craze, and soon students everywhere were copying the moves.
exzh: 那支舞蔚為風潮，不久各地的學生都在模仿舞步。

en: Workers should never be forced to do degrading tasks that make them feel worthless.
exzh: 不應該強迫員工做讓他們覺得自己毫無價值、有辱人格的工作。

en: Nurses and doctors on the frontline worked long hours to care for patients during the outbreak.
exzh: 疫情期間，第一線的護理師和醫生長時間工作照顧病人。
note: 亦可作形容詞，如 frontline workers

en: Volunteers built a small library in an impoverished village so that children could borrow books.
exzh: 志願者在一個貧困的村莊蓋了一間小圖書館，讓孩子們可以借書。

en: He was ostensibly studying in the library, but he was really playing a game.
exzh: 他表面上是在圖書館讀書，其實是在玩遊戲。
note: 暗示真實情況與表面不同

en: She is an outspoken student who always shares her honest opinion during class discussions.
exzh: 她是個直言不諱的學生，在課堂討論中總是說出自己的真實看法。

en: He gave a phony smile that nobody believed, because everyone knew he was upset.
exzh: 他露出一個沒人相信的假笑，因為大家都知道他很不開心。

en: Doctors used a scan to pinpoint the exact cause of the patient's pain.
exzh: 醫生利用掃描精確找出病人疼痛的確切原因。

en: The young swimmer showed great prowess and broke the school record twice in one day.
exzh: 這位年輕的游泳選手展現了高超的本領，一天之內兩度打破校內紀錄。

en: After the holiday, the store hours will revert to normal on Monday morning.
exzh: 假期過後，商店的營業時間將在週一早上恢復正常。
note: revert to 回到原本的狀態

en: Three teams will vie for the top prize in the regional science contest this weekend.
exzh: 三支隊伍本週末將在區域科學競賽中爭奪首獎。
note: 常搭配 vie for / vie with

en: Strict adherence to the safety rules kept everyone in the science lab out of danger.
exzh: 嚴格遵守安全規則，讓實驗室裡的每個人都沒有遇到危險。

en: A benevolent businessman gave free lunches to children from poor families every day.
exzh: 一位仁慈的商人每天免費提供午餐給貧困家庭的孩子。

zh: 邊緣的；介於兩者之間的
en: His score was borderline, so the teacher read his essay again before deciding the grade.
exzh: 他的分數剛好在邊緣，所以老師在決定成績之前又讀了一次他的作文。

zh: 利用；以大寫書寫；把……資本化
en: Smart shop owners capitalize on holidays by offering special discounts and decorations to attract customers.
exzh: 精明的店主會利用節日提供特別折扣和裝飾來吸引顧客。

en: The new class leader has so much charisma that everyone enjoys listening to her speeches.
exzh: 新任班長很有魅力，大家都喜歡聽她演講。

en: Good sleep helps cognition, so students remember more of what they study.
exzh: 充足的睡眠有助於認知能力，使學生記得更多所讀的內容。

zh: 令人垂涎的；夢寐以求的
en: She finally won the coveted first prize in the national science competition.
exzh: 她終於贏得全國科學競賽中夢寐以求的第一名。

en: The devout villagers walk to the old temple every morning to light incense and pray.
exzh: 虔誠的村民每天早上走到古老的廟裡上香祈禱。

en: The small shop paid a disproportionate share of the costs compared with the big stores.
exzh: 這家小店與大型商店相比，負擔了不成比例的高額費用。

zh: 造成分裂的；引起對立的
en: The plan to close the old park was divisive, and neighbors argued about it for weeks.
exzh: 關閉老公園的計畫引起了對立，鄰居們為此爭論了好幾週。

en: The new library seems to embody the town's wish for a more open, learning-friendly future.
exzh: 這座新圖書館似乎體現了小鎮對更開放、重視學習的未來的期望。

en: A long silence ensued after the teacher asked who had broken the classroom window.
exzh: 老師問是誰打破教室窗戶之後，隨即是一陣長長的沉默。
note: 形容詞 ensuing 隨之而來的

en: The weather in spring is often erratic, with sunshine in the morning and rain by noon.
exzh: 春天的天氣常常變化無常，早上出太陽，中午就下雨。

en: It would be folly to go hiking in the mountains without water or a map.
exzh: 沒帶水或地圖就去爬山，那將是愚蠢的行為。

en: The company expects prices to stay the same for the foreseeable future.
exzh: 公司預期在可預見的未來，價格會維持不變。
note: in the foreseeable future 在可預見的未來

en: With hindsight, I should have started studying earlier instead of waiting until the night before the exam.
exzh: 事後回想，我應該早點開始讀書，而不是等到考前一晚。

en: It is ludicrous to expect the team to win after they stopped practicing for a month.
exzh: 期待這支隊伍在停止練習一個月後還能贏球，實在太荒謬了。

en: She said it as a joke, without any malice, but he felt hurt anyway.
exzh: 她只是開玩笑，並沒有任何惡意，但他還是覺得受傷。

en: Programs that help marginalized groups often provide free tutoring and meals for children.
exzh: 幫助被邊緣化群體的計畫，通常會為孩子提供免費課輔和餐點。

en: Math was his nemesis in school, but he finally beat it by practicing a little every day.
exzh: 數學是他在學校的剋星，但他每天練習一點終於戰勝了它。

en: The revered teacher was loved by generations of students who still visit her every year.
exzh: 這位受人敬重的老師深受一屆又一屆學生愛戴，他們至今每年仍會去探望她。

en: Spreading false stories about a classmate is slander, and it can hurt his reputation.
exzh: 散播關於同學的不實傳聞就是誹謗，可能傷害他的名聲。
note: 口頭誹謗；書面誹謗為 libel

zh: 光滑的；流線型的；時髦的
en: The company introduced a sleek new laptop that is thinner and lighter than before.
exzh: 公司推出一款外型時髦的新筆電，比以前更薄更輕。

en: Researchers studied how socioeconomic factors such as income and education affect children's health.
exzh: 研究人員探討收入和教育等社會經濟因素如何影響兒童的健康。

zh: 不可否認的；無可爭辯的
en: There is undeniable evidence that regular exercise helps people sleep better at night.
exzh: 有無可否認的證據顯示，規律運動能幫助人們夜晚睡得更好。

en: Drivers must stay vigilant on rainy nights because the road is slippery and dark.
exzh: 雨夜裡路面濕滑又昏暗，駕駛人必須保持警覺。

en: My cousin is adept at fixing bicycles and often helps the neighbors with repairs.
exzh: 我表哥很擅長修腳踏車，常幫鄰居修理。

en: High parking fees can be a deterrent to people who might otherwise drive downtown every day.
exzh: 高額停車費可能嚇阻原本每天會開車進市區的人。

en: The critic looked at the cheap copy with disdain and walked quickly away.
exzh: 評論家以不屑的眼神看著那件廉價的仿製品，然後快步走開。

en: An eerie silence filled the forest after the birds suddenly stopped singing.
exzh: 鳥兒突然停止鳴叫後，一股詭異的寂靜籠罩了森林。

en: The number of users showed exponential growth, doubling every month for almost a year.
exzh: 使用者人數呈現指數成長，將近一年每個月都翻倍。

en: The meeting turned into a farce when three people spoke at once and nobody could be heard.
exzh: 三個人同時說話、誰也聽不清楚，那場會議變成了一場鬧劇。

en: The two neighbors finally ended their long grudge and shared a meal together.
exzh: 這兩位鄰居終於結束了長久的嫌隙，一起吃了一頓飯。
note: hold a grudge 懷恨在心

en: Exam week was so hectic that I hardly had time to eat dinner.
exzh: 考試週忙得不可開交，我幾乎沒有時間吃晚餐。

en: A holistic approach to health considers sleep, food, exercise, and mental well-being together.
exzh: 整體性的健康觀會一併考慮睡眠、飲食、運動和心理健康。

en: Many users find it intrusive when an app keeps asking for access to their photos and location.
exzh: 許多使用者覺得應用程式一直要求存取照片和位置，是種侵擾。

en: The speaker tried to invoke a sense of pride by talking about the school's long history.
exzh: 講者試圖藉由談論學校悠久的歷史來喚起大家的榮譽感。

en: The owner was negligent, and he forgot to check the machines before leaving the shop.
exzh: 老闆疏忽大意，離開店面前忘了檢查機器。

en: Engineers worked all night to optimize the app so that it would load faster.
exzh: 工程師整晚努力將應用程式最佳化，讓它載入得更快。

en: Washing your hands with soap helps remove pathogens that can cause illnesses such as the flu.
exzh: 用肥皂洗手有助於清除可能引起流感等疾病的病原體。

en: In an emergency, saving lives takes precedence over protecting buildings.
exzh: 在緊急情況下，拯救生命比保護建築物更優先。

zh: 原始未受破壞的；嶄新的
en: The lake is pristine, with clear water and no sign of rubbish around it.
exzh: 這座湖保持原始狀態，湖水清澈，周圍看不到任何垃圾。

en: There is an uncanny likeness between the twins, and even their teachers confuse them.
exzh: 這對雙胞胎有著驚人的相似，連老師也會把他們搞混。

en: The school's ethos is based on respect, honesty, and helping others in the community.
exzh: 這所學校的精神以尊重、誠實和幫助社區他人為基礎。

en: Many old folk songs have faded into oblivion because no one sings them anymore.
exzh: 許多古老的民謠已漸漸被遺忘，因為再也沒有人唱它們了。

zh: 樂於接受的；善於接納的
en: The teacher was receptive to new ideas and often changed lessons after listening to students.
exzh: 那位老師樂於接受新想法，常在聽取學生意見後調整課程。

en: This reversible jacket can be worn with the blue side or the gray side out.
exzh: 這件雙面外套可以穿藍色面或灰色面在外。

en: It is simplistic to say that one poor test score alone explains why a student failed the course.
exzh: 光說一次考不好就能解釋學生為何這門課不及格，是過度簡化。

zh: 難以估計的；數不清的；未透露的
en: The storm caused untold damage to the farms, and many families lost their crops.
exzh: 這場風暴對農場造成難以估計的損失，許多家庭失去了作物。
note: untold stories 不為人知的故事

zh: 振奮人心的；令人精神一振的
en: The uplifting story of the girl who learned to walk again made everyone smile.
exzh: 那個女孩重新學會走路的故事振奮人心，讓每個人都露出笑容。

en: The doctor found a small abnormality in the scan and asked for another test.
exzh: 醫生在掃描中發現一處小小的異常，並要求再做一次檢查。

en: A cohesive team trusts one another and works together to reach shared goals, even when things get hard.
exzh: 有凝聚力的團隊彼此信任，即使遇到困難也會合作達成共同目標。

en: The plan to close the old library was contentious, and many residents spoke against it.
exzh: 關閉舊圖書館的計畫很有爭議，許多居民出面反對。

en: Planting trees can help restore degraded land that has lost most of its soil.
exzh: 種樹可以幫助恢復已經流失大部分土壤的退化土地。

en: Workers will dismantle the old stage after the school festival ends on Friday.
exzh: 校慶結束後的星期五，工人將拆除舊舞台。

en: To many fans, the old goalkeeper was the embodiment of courage and hard work.
exzh: 對許多球迷來說，那位老守門員是勇氣與努力的化身。

en: Old habits are entrenched, so it takes time and patience to change them.
exzh: 舊習慣根深蒂固，所以要改變它們需要時間和耐心。

en: The teacher found several irregularities in the records and asked the students to check them.
exzh: 老師在記錄中發現幾處異常，請學生們再檢查一遍。

en: Visitors easily got lost in the labyrinth of narrow streets in the old town.
exzh: 遊客很容易在老城區錯綜複雜的窄巷中迷路。
note: 與 maze 近義，較文學化

en: He was oblivious to the noise outside because he was so focused on finishing his homework.
exzh: 他太專心寫功課，對外面的吵鬧聲渾然不覺。

en: The city has seen a resurgence of interest in cycling since the new bike paths opened.
exzh: 自從新的自行車道啟用後，這座城市對騎單車的興趣再度興起。

zh: 自鳴得意的；沾沾自喜的
en: He wore a smug smile after winning the game, which annoyed his friends.
exzh: 他贏了比賽後露出得意洋洋的笑容，讓他的朋友們很不高興。

en: The stagnant water in the pond became a perfect place for mosquitoes to grow.
exzh: 池塘裡不流動的水成了蚊子孳生的絕佳地點。

en: The principal commended the students for their hard work in cleaning up the neighborhood park.
exzh: 校長表揚學生努力清掃社區公園。

en: The test results were not conclusive, so the doctors asked for another check next week.
exzh: 檢查結果並不明確，所以醫生要求下週再做一次檢查。

en: The school play turned into a fiasco when the lights failed in the middle of the show.
exzh: 演出進行到一半燈光故障，這齣校內話劇變成了一場慘敗。

en: His meddling in the group project annoyed his classmates, who wanted to finish the work alone.
exzh: 他對小組報告的干涉惹惱了同學，他們想自己完成工作。

en: Many new factories were built on the periphery of the city, where land was cheaper.
exzh: 許多新工廠蓋在市區的外圍，那裡土地比較便宜。

en: Opinions in the town were polarized, with some people loving the new mall and others hating it.
exzh: 鎮上的意見兩極化，有些人喜歡新商場，有些人討厭它。

en: The quiet morning was only a prelude to a very busy day of activities.
exzh: 平靜的早晨只是繁忙的活動日的前奏。

en: She writes a blog about her favorite hiking trails and shares photos every weekend.
exzh: 她寫了一個介紹自己最愛的登山步道的部落格，每個週末都會分享照片。

en: On the first day of camp, every new student was given a buddy to show them around.
exzh: 營隊第一天，每位新生都被分配一位夥伴帶他們熟悉環境。
note: 口語用字；buddy system 夥伴制

en: The dean of the college welcomed the new students and explained how the courses work.
exzh: 學院院長歡迎新生，並說明課程如何運作。

en: I like this song because the lyrics talk about friendship and never giving up.
exzh: 我喜歡這首歌，因為歌詞談的是友誼與永不放棄。

zh: 首位的；支配地位的；希臘字母 α
en: The alpha wolf leads the pack and decides when the group should hunt or rest.
exzh: 首領狼帶領狼群，並決定群體何時該狩獵或休息。
note: alpha male 首領型的雄性；Alpha 也是希臘字母第一個

en: The museum has a model of a naval ship that sailed around the world a hundred years ago.
exzh: 博物館有一艘一百年前環遊世界的海軍艦艇模型。

en: Always make a backup of your homework files in case your computer suddenly stops working.
exzh: 一定要備份你的作業檔案，以防電腦突然無法運作。
note: 動詞片語 back up；backup plan 備案

en: The company released a beta of the new app so that users could report problems.
exzh: 公司釋出了新應用程式的測試版，讓使用者回報問題。

en: A ram with large curved horns stood proudly on top of the hill.
exzh: 一隻長著彎曲大角的公羊驕傲地站在山丘頂上。

en: After the storm, part of the power grid failed, and many homes had no electricity for a day.
exzh: 暴風雨過後，部分電網故障，許多家庭停電一天。

en: Rich soil carried by the river formed a wide delta where farmers grow rice.
exzh: 河流帶來的肥沃泥土形成了一片廣闊的三角洲，農民在那裡種稻。

en: The students' artwork was hung on the walls of the school hallway for parents to see.
exzh: 學生的藝術作品被掛在學校走廊的牆上，供家長欣賞。
note: 不可數；指整體作品或書中的插圖

en: The baby laughed and patted his round belly after finishing a big bowl of soup.
exzh: 寶寶喝完一大碗湯後，笑著拍拍自己圓圓的肚子。
note: 口語，比 stomach 更隨意

en: My grandmother makes a sweet jam from fresh figs and spreads it on warm toast.
exzh: 我奶奶用新鮮無花果做甜果醬，塗在溫熱的吐司上。

en: The setup of the new classroom projector took only ten minutes with the teacher's help.
exzh: 在老師的協助下，新教室投影機的設置只花了十分鐘。

en: The singing duo performed at the school festival and received a loud round of applause.
exzh: 這組二人合唱團在校慶上表演，獲得熱烈的掌聲。

en: Tall reeds grow along the river, giving small birds a safe place to build nests.
exzh: 高高的蘆葦長在河邊，為小鳥提供築巢的安全地點。

en: In the folk tale, a brave boy tricks a demon that has been scaring the villagers.
exzh: 在民間故事中，一個勇敢的男孩騙過了一直嚇唬村民的惡魔。

en: The concert ended with a grand finale, and the audience stood up to clap.
exzh: 音樂會以盛大的壓軸演出作結，觀眾都起立鼓掌。

en: The children dressed up as a vampire and a witch for the school costume party.
exzh: 孩子們在學校的變裝派對上扮成吸血鬼與女巫。

en: This ring is made of platinum, which is harder and rarer than silver.
exzh: 這枚戒指是用白金做的，比銀更堅硬也更稀有。

en: The bear returned to its den in the mountains to sleep through the cold winter.
exzh: 那隻熊回到山裡的洞穴，睡過寒冷的冬天。

en: Farmers use a drone with a small camera to check how their crops are growing.
exzh: 農民使用配備小型相機的無人機來檢查作物的生長狀況。

en: The library's holdings include more than fifty thousand books and many old maps.
exzh: 這座圖書館的館藏包括五萬多本書與許多古地圖。
note: 亦指持股；此處為館藏意

en: In physics class, we learned that a vector has both size and direction.
exzh: 在物理課上，我們學到向量同時具有大小和方向。
note: 亦指傳播疾病的媒介，如蚊子

en: I enjoyed the first book so much that I immediately bought the sequel to find out what happens next.
exzh: 我太喜歡第一本書，立刻買了續集想知道接下來發生什麼事。

en: The museum displayed a piece of amber that holds a tiny insect from millions of years ago.
exzh: 博物館展出了一塊琥珀，裡面封存著數百萬年前的一隻小昆蟲。
note: 也指交通號誌的黃燈（amber light）

en: Teachers learn to support students with autism by using clear and simple instructions.
exzh: 老師學習用清楚簡單的指示來支持有自閉症的學生。

en: The university moved up in the world rankings thanks to its strong research results.
exzh: 這所大學因為研究成果亮眼，在世界排名中往上提升。

en: I have too many tabs open in my browser, and my computer is getting slow.
exzh: 我瀏覽器開了太多分頁，電腦變得很慢。
note: 也可指餐廳帳單（pick up the tab）

en: The buses return to the depot every night, where workers clean and check them.
exzh: 公車每晚回到停車場，工作人員會在那裡清潔並檢查它們。

en: Blood is made of red cells, white cells, and plasma, which is the yellow liquid part.
exzh: 血液由紅血球、白血球與血漿構成，血漿是黃色的液體部分。
note: 物理學中指電漿，是第四態物質

en: My friend is vegan, so she does not eat meat, eggs, milk, or cheese.
exzh: 我的朋友吃純素，所以她不吃肉、蛋、牛奶或起司。
note: vegan 不含任何動物製品；vegetarian 可吃蛋奶

en: The cafe has a relaxed vibe, with soft music and warm lights that make it great for reading.
exzh: 這間咖啡館氣氛輕鬆，柔和的音樂和溫暖的燈光很適合看書。

en: The students dressed as a zombie and a pirate for the school's Halloween party.
exzh: 學生們在學校的萬聖節派對上打扮成殭屍和海盜。

en: The scientist used a sonic device to measure how deep the lake was.
exzh: 那位科學家用一個聲波裝置來測量湖有多深。

en: The plane slowly moved down the runway before lifting into the evening sky.
exzh: 飛機沿著跑道緩慢滑行，然後飛入傍晚的天空。

en: The library's online catalog lets you search for books by title, author, or subject.
exzh: 圖書館的線上目錄讓你可以依書名、作者或主題搜尋書籍。

en: On weekends, street performers entertain visitors in the plaza in front of the old temple.
exzh: 週末時，街頭藝人在古老廟宇前的廣場上為遊客表演。

en: The bank keeps its gold and important papers in a strong vault under the building.
exzh: 銀行把黃金與重要文件存放在大樓地下一個堅固的金庫裡。
note: 亦可作動詞，指跳過、撐竿跳

en: Many alumni returned to the school to celebrate its hundredth birthday.
exzh: 許多校友回到母校慶祝建校一百週年。

en: Each module of the online course takes about two hours and ends with a short quiz.
exzh: 這門線上課程的每個單元約兩小時，結尾有一個小測驗。

zh: 失控的；脫離常軌的；流氓
en: A rogue wave suddenly rose from the sea and surprised the sailors on the small boat.
exzh: 一道突如其來的異常巨浪從海中升起，嚇了小船上的水手一跳。
note: rogue wave 異常波（瘋狗浪）

en: Each computer in the network is called a node and can send data to the others.
exzh: 網路中的每一台電腦都稱為一個節點，可以傳送資料給其他電腦。

en: A giant billboard beside the highway advertises a new brand of fruit juice.
exzh: 高速公路旁的一面巨大廣告看板在宣傳一種新的果汁。

en: The nurse placed a hand on the child's forehead to check whether he had a fever.
exzh: 護理師把手放在孩子的額頭上，檢查他是否發燒。

en: This small bookshop is a hidden gem that most tourists never find.
exzh: 這家小書店是遊客大多找不到的隱藏珍寶。

en: The old bridge was built with granite, a very hard stone that lasts for centuries.
exzh: 這座老橋是用花崗岩建造的，這種很堅硬的石頭可以保存好幾個世紀。

en: Regular exercise can lower the risk of cardiac disease and keep your heart strong.
exzh: 規律運動可以降低心臟疾病的風險，讓心臟保持強健。

en: A wide ramp at the entrance lets people in wheelchairs and parents with strollers enter the building easily.
exzh: 入口處的寬坡道讓輪椅使用者和推嬰兒車的家長能輕鬆進入大樓。

en: The villagers often visited the old sage to ask for advice about farming and family life.
exzh: 村民常去拜訪那位年長的智者，請教耕作與家庭生活方面的建議。

en: The congregation gathered in the hall every Sunday to sing and listen to a talk.
exzh: 會眾每個星期天都聚集在大廳裡唱歌與聽講。

en: Geological studies show that the mountain was formed millions of years ago.
exzh: 地質研究顯示，這座山是在數百萬年前形成的。

en: Every cell in your body is surrounded by a thin membrane that controls what goes in and out.
exzh: 你身體的每個細胞都被一層薄膜包圍，控制著什麼可以進出。

en: Plants take in carbon dioxide from the air and use it to make food.
exzh: 植物從空氣中吸收二氧化碳，並用它來製造養分。

en: The body needs insulin to move sugar from the blood into the cells.
exzh: 身體需要胰島素把糖分從血液送進細胞裡。
note: 糖尿病與血糖控制相關

en: Fresh flowers and fruit were placed on the altar before the ceremony began.
exzh: 儀式開始前，鮮花和水果被擺放在祭壇上。

en: I looked in the atlas to find the exact location of the small island mentioned in the news.
exzh: 我翻閱地圖集，找出新聞中提到的那座小島的確切位置。

en: After the muddy football game, our shoes were so filthy that we left them outside.
exzh: 在泥濘的足球賽之後，我們的鞋子髒透了，只好留在門外。

en: Choose a clear font so that the audience can read your slides from the back.
exzh: 選擇清楚的字型，這樣坐在後面的觀眾才看得到你的投影片。

en: I watched a short video tutorial to learn how to edit photos on my phone.
exzh: 我看了一支簡短的教學影片，學習如何在手機上修照片。

en: The farmer used a sharp axe to cut firewood for the cold winter nights.
exzh: 農夫用一把鋒利的斧頭砍柴，準備度過寒冷的冬夜。

zh: 固定裝置；固定設備；（體育）賽事
en: The apartment comes with basic fixtures such as lamps, sinks, and built-in cupboards.
exzh: 這間公寓附有基本的固定設備，例如燈具、水槽和嵌入式櫥櫃。
note: input 為複數 fixtures，改教單數 fixture；英式英語中 fixtures 也指賽程（重複，已刪）

en: The committee held public hearings to listen to what local people thought about the new road.
exzh: 委員會舉行了公開聽證會，聆聽當地居民對新道路的想法。

en: A black raven sat on the fence and watched the children play in the yard.
exzh: 一隻黑色渡鴉停在圍籬上，看著孩子們在院子裡玩耍。

en: Special receptors in your nose detect smells and send signals to your brain.
exzh: 你鼻子裡的特殊受體會偵測氣味，並把訊號傳到大腦。

en: She picked a white daisy from the grass and put it in a small glass of water.
exzh: 她從草地上摘了一朵白色雛菊，放進一小杯水裡。

en: He cut a small notch in the stick for each day he spent on the island.
exzh: 他在樹枝上每天刻一道小痕，記錄自己在島上度過的日子。
note: 亦指等級，如 a notch above；top-notch 一流的

en: Dozens of fans formed a long queue outside the bookstore to buy the new novel.
exzh: 幾十位書迷在書店外排成長長的隊伍，要買新出的小說。
note: 英式用法，美式多用 line；queue up 排隊

en: The shop uses analytics to see which products customers look at most often on its website.
exzh: 這家店利用數據分析來了解顧客在網站上最常瀏覽哪些商品。

en: Her grandmother wore a floral dress with pink and yellow flowers to the family party.
exzh: 她的祖母穿著一件有粉紅色與黃色花朵圖案的花洋裝，參加家庭聚會。

en: Each player rolls the dice and moves the piece forward by the number shown.
exzh: 每位玩家擲骰子，並依點數把棋子往前移動。
note: 單數 die；亦可作動詞，指切丁

en: The iris is the colored part of the eye that controls how much light comes in.
exzh: 虹膜是眼睛有顏色的部分，控制進入眼睛的光線多寡。

en: Scientists are studying the neural connections in the brain to understand how we learn new skills.
exzh: 科學家研究大腦中的神經連結，以了解我們如何學會新技能。

en: A small rover moved slowly across the surface of Mars and sent photos back to Earth.
exzh: 一輛小型探測車在火星表面緩慢移動，並把照片傳回地球。

en: The team gave a stellar performance and won the national science contest.
exzh: 這支團隊表現傑出，贏得了全國科學競賽。
note: 亦指恆星的，如 stellar light

en: Many students still follow the teachings of the ancient thinker in their daily lives.
exzh: 許多學生在日常生活中仍遵循這位古代思想家的教誨。

en: I felt a small twitch in my eye after staying up all night to study.
exzh: 我熬夜讀書之後，感到眼睛輕微抽動。

en: In the famous story, Noah built a huge ark to save his family and many animals.
exzh: 在那個著名的故事裡，諾亞建造了一艘巨大的方舟，來拯救他的家人和許多動物。

en: The school will enlist student volunteers to help clean the park this weekend.
exzh: 學校將招募學生志工在這個週末幫忙打掃公園。

en: After a meal, your body breaks down food into glucose, which gives your cells energy.
exzh: 用餐後，你的身體會把食物分解成葡萄糖，為細胞提供能量。

en: A faint halo appeared around the moon, and my grandfather said that rain was coming.
exzh: 月亮周圍出現一圈淡淡的光暈，我爺爺說快要下雨了。

en: The cave was formed over thousands of years as water slowly dissolved the limestone underground.
exzh: 這個洞穴是在數千年間，水慢慢溶解地下石灰岩而形成的。

en: The fisherman used a net with a fine mesh to catch small fish.
exzh: 漁夫用網眼細小的網來捕捉小魚。
note: 亦可作動詞，表示契合、配合

en: She studies at a veterinary college because she wants to take care of sick animals.
exzh: 她就讀獸醫學院，因為她想照顧生病的動物。

en: The hospital has an auxiliary generator that starts automatically when the main power goes out.
exzh: 醫院有一台輔助發電機，在主電源中斷時會自動啟動。

en: The lighthouse was a beacon that guided ships safely through the dark and foggy night.
exzh: 那座燈塔就像一盞指引的明燈，在漆黑多霧的夜晚引導船隻安全通過。
note: 也可比喻為希望或指引：a beacon of hope

en: Autumn brings a bounty of fruit, and the market is full of apples and pears.
exzh: 秋天帶來豐富的水果，市場上堆滿了蘋果與梨子。

en: Members of the clergy from several communities attended the opening of the charity event.
exzh: 來自幾個社區的神職人員出席了這場慈善活動的開幕式。
note: 集合名詞，通常搭配複數動詞

en: After the accident, the patient stayed in a coma for two weeks before he woke up.
exzh: 意外發生後，病人昏迷了兩週才醒來。
note: in a coma 處於昏迷

en: The falcon flew high above the valley, then suddenly dived to catch a small bird.
exzh: 那隻獵鷹在山谷上空高高飛翔，然後突然俯衝下來捕捉一隻小鳥。

en: You can read the downloaded articles offline when you are on a plane.
exzh: 你搭飛機時，可以離線閱讀已下載的文章。

en: The painter mixed blue and yellow on her palette to make a bright green.
exzh: 畫家在調色盤上混合藍色和黃色，調出明亮的綠色。
note: 亦指整體配色 color palette

en: Doctors made a serum from the blood of recovered patients to help treat the disease.
exzh: 醫生用康復病人的血液製成血清，以協助治療這種疾病。

en: My grandfather still prefers his old analog watch with hands to a digital one.
exzh: 我的祖父仍然喜歡他那只有指針的舊式類比手錶，而不是電子錶。
note: 反義 digital；英式拼法 analogue

en: They spent the afternoon at the arcade playing racing games and winning small prizes.
exzh: 他們整個下午都待在電玩遊樂場玩賽車遊戲，還贏了一些小獎品。

en: Tourists traveled to the far north hoping to see the green aurora dancing in the night sky.
exzh: 遊客前往遙遠的北方，希望看到夜空中舞動的綠色極光。

en: A bacterial infection can usually be treated with medicine, but a cold caused by a virus cannot.
exzh: 細菌感染通常可以用藥物治療，但病毒引起的感冒則不行。

en: Water and sugar are the main constituents of this fruit juice.
exzh: 水和糖是這種果汁的主要成分。
note: input 為複數 constituents，改教單數 constituent；另一常見義為「選民」（重複，已刪）

en: The contract was declared null because one of the sides had not signed it.
exzh: 這份合約因為有一方沒有簽名而被宣告無效。
note: null and void 無效；程式中指空值

en: The café has a retro style, with old posters on the walls and a vintage radio.
exzh: 這間咖啡館有復古風格，牆上掛著舊海報，還有一台老式收音機。

en: The store sells sports apparel such as running shirts, jackets, and comfortable shorts.
exzh: 這家店賣運動服飾，例如跑步上衣、外套和舒適的短褲。

en: The workers used a hydraulic machine, powered by liquid pressure, to lift the heavy stones.
exzh: 工人們使用以液體壓力驅動的液壓機來抬起沉重的石頭。

en: The speaker used inflammatory words that made the crowd angry and loud.
exzh: 那位講者用了煽動性的言詞，使群眾變得憤怒又吵鬧。

en: If you zoom in too much on the picture, you can see each tiny pixel.
exzh: 如果你把圖片放大太多，就可以看到每個微小的像素。

en: In the sentence "Birds fly south in winter," the word "fly" is the verb.
exzh: 在「Birds fly south in winter」這個句子中，fly 是動詞。

zh: 經認證的；獲正式認可的
en: Only accredited schools can offer this official certificate to their graduating students.
exzh: 只有經過認證的學校才能向畢業學生頒發這份正式證書。

en: The singer reached the apex of her career when she won a famous music award.
exzh: 這位歌手在拿到一個著名的音樂獎時，事業達到了巔峰。

en: A huge boulder rolled down the hill and stopped just beside the road.
exzh: 一顆巨石從山坡滾下來，剛好停在路邊。

en: An infrared camera can detect heat, so it is often used to find people in the dark.
exzh: 紅外線相機能偵測熱量，所以常被用來在黑暗中找人。

en: The brain contains billions of neurons that send tiny signals to one another.
exzh: 大腦含有數十億個神經元，彼此傳遞微小的訊號。

en: We visited the observatory and used a large telescope to look at the moon.
exzh: 我們參觀了天文台，用一架大望遠鏡觀看月亮。

zh: 豆莢；（太空船或設備的）艙
en: Peas grow inside a green pod, which opens when the seeds are ripe.
exzh: 豌豆長在綠色豆莢裡，種子成熟時豆莢就會裂開。
note: 亦指艙，如 escape pod；鯨魚群也叫 pod

en: In the legend, an old prophecy said that a great flood would one day cover the valley.
exzh: 傳說中有一則古老的預言，說有一天大洪水會淹沒山谷。

en: In geometry class, we used a famous theorem to find the length of the missing side.
exzh: 在幾何課上，我們運用一個著名的定理求出缺少的那條邊的長度。

en: A beautiful vista of the sea opened up when we reached the top of the road.
exzh: 我們到達道路盡頭的高處時，眼前展開一幅美麗的海景。

en: She sprinkled a little cinnamon on top of the warm apple pie.
exzh: 她在溫熱的蘋果派上撒了一點肉桂粉。

en: On a crisp autumn morning, we ate warm bread and fresh, crisp apples by the lake.
exzh: 在一個清爽的秋天早晨，我們在湖邊吃著溫熱的麵包和新鮮脆甜的蘋果。

en: She spent two years writing her dissertation about how bees help flowers produce seeds.
exzh: 她花了兩年寫關於蜜蜂如何幫助花朵結種子的學位論文。

en: The island's flora includes many rare flowers that cannot be found anywhere else.
exzh: 這座島的植物群包括許多在別處找不到的珍稀花卉。

en: Scientists completed the map of the human genome, which contains all of our genetic information.
exzh: 科學家完成了人類基因組的圖譜，其中包含我們全部的遺傳資訊。

en: The truck drove slowly along the gravel road, throwing small stones against the fence.
exzh: 卡車沿著碎石路慢慢行駛，把小石子濺到圍欄上。

en: Tea grows well in the cool highlands, where the air is clean and mist is common.
exzh: 茶在涼爽的高地長得很好，那裡空氣清新，常有薄霧。

en: The city celebrated the new millennium with a huge firework show at midnight.
exzh: 這座城市在午夜以盛大的煙火秀慶祝新的千禧年。

en: In the ancient legend, travelers visited the oracle to ask what their future would be.
exzh: 在古老的傳說中，旅人前往拜訪神諭，詢問自己的未來。

en: On April Fools' Day, my brother played a harmless prank by hiding all of my left socks.
exzh: 愚人節那天，我哥哥開了個無傷大雅的玩笑，把我所有左腳的襪子都藏起來。

en: After medical school, she began her residency at a large hospital in the city.
exzh: 醫學院畢業後，她在市內一家大醫院開始住院醫師訓練。

en: He bought a pair of gray trousers to wear with his white shirt at the ceremony.
exzh: 他買了一條灰色長褲，典禮上要搭配白襯衫穿。
note: 美式常用 pants；一條長褲 a pair of trousers

en: In the online game, each player chooses an avatar that looks like a different animal.
exzh: 在這款線上遊戲中，每位玩家都選擇一個長得像不同動物的虛擬化身。

en: Fast broadband has made it possible for students in remote villages to take classes online.
exzh: 高速寬頻讓偏遠村落的學生也能上線上課程。

en: As the eldest child, he often helped his parents take care of his younger sisters.
exzh: 身為最年長的孩子，他常幫忙父母照顧年紀較小的妹妹們。
note: 三個以上用 eldest；兩個則用 elder

en: She wants to study forestry so that she can help protect the mountains and forests.
exzh: 她想攻讀林業，這樣就能幫忙保護山林。

en: The runner felt tired midway through the race but refused to give up.
exzh: 這位選手在比賽進行到一半時感到疲累，但仍不肯放棄。

en: Brushing your teeth twice a day removes plaque and helps prevent cavities.
exzh: 每天刷牙兩次可以清除牙菌斑，並幫助預防蛀牙。

en: He kicked the ball so hard that it hit his friend's shin, and it hurt a little.
exzh: 他把球踢得太用力，打到朋友的小腿前側，有點痛。

en: The company grew into a titan of the technology industry in only twenty years.
exzh: 這家公司在短短二十年內成長為科技產業的巨擘。
note: 原指希臘神話中的泰坦巨神

en: A willow tree beside the pond moved gently as the wind blew across the water.
exzh: 池塘邊的柳樹隨著風吹過水面輕輕擺動。

en: The archaeological team spent the summer carefully digging up an ancient village near the coast.
exzh: 考古隊整個夏天都在海邊小心翼翼地挖掘一座古村落。

en: Swimming and cycling are good cardiovascular exercises that make your heart stronger.
exzh: 游泳和騎單車是很好的心血管運動，能讓你的心臟更強健。

en: She looked chic in a simple black dress and a small silver necklace.
exzh: 她穿著簡單的黑色洋裝，搭配一條銀色小項鍊，看起來雅致時髦。

en: The driver turned the key in the ignition, and the engine started with a low sound.
exzh: 駕駛轉動點火開關的鑰匙，引擎隨著低沉的聲音發動了。

en: Doctors warn that children who are obese have a higher chance of health problems later in life.
exzh: 醫生警告，肥胖的兒童日後出現健康問題的機率較高。

en: To find the perimeter of the garden, add up the lengths of all four sides.
exzh: 要求出花園的周長，就把四邊的長度全部加起來。

en: Paper is made from wood pulp, which is soft and wet before it is pressed.
exzh: 紙是用木漿製成的，壓製之前它又軟又濕。

en: Some diseases are airborne, so wearing a mask helps protect people in crowded rooms.
exzh: 有些疾病會經由空氣傳播，所以戴口罩能保護擁擠房間裡的人。
note: airborne disease 空氣傳播疾病

en: The delivery truck left a small dent in the side of our garage door.
exzh: 送貨卡車在我們車庫門的側邊留下一個小凹痕。
note: make a dent in 也比喻「有明顯進展」

en: The school held a gala at the end of the year, with music, food, and dancing.
exzh: 學校在年底舉辦了一場慶祝晚會，有音樂、美食和舞蹈。

en: Good insulation in the walls keeps the house warm in winter and cool in summer.
exzh: 牆壁裡良好的隔熱材料讓房子冬暖夏涼。
note: 動詞 insulate；亦指電的絕緣

en: A mole is a small animal that digs long tunnels under the garden soil.
exzh: 鼴鼠是一種小動物，會在花園土壤下挖出長長的隧道。
note: 一字多義：皮膚上的痣、鼴鼠、化學單位 mole 莫耳

en: He went on a long rant about how the bus was late again and the weather was terrible.
exzh: 他長篇大論地抱怨公車又誤點了、天氣又糟透了。

en: The museum sells a small replica of the ancient bronze bell for visitors to take home.
exzh: 博物館販售那只古代青銅鐘的小型複製品，讓遊客帶回家。

en: Blockchain is a technology that records data in connected blocks that are hard to change.
exzh: 區塊鏈是一種把資料記錄在相連區塊中、不易被更改的技術。

zh: 包租的；特許的；有執照的
en: The school booked a chartered bus to take all the students to the science museum.
exzh: 學校包了一輛遊覽車，載全體學生前往科學博物館。

en: The company closed down and still owes a large amount of money to its creditors.
exzh: 這家公司歇業了，卻仍欠債權人一大筆錢。

en: In the fable, the hare was so sure of winning that it stopped to take a nap.
exzh: 在這則寓言裡，兔子對勝利太有把握，於是停下來睡了一覺。
note: hare 為野兔；rabbit 為家兔

en: She took maternity leave for three months to care for her newborn baby.
exzh: 她請了三個月的產假來照顧剛出生的寶寶。

zh: 書呆子；對某領域極度投入的人
en: My brother is a computer nerd who spends all weekend building small robots.
exzh: 我哥哥是個電腦宅，整個週末都在組裝小機器人。

en: Website optimization makes pages load faster, which keeps visitors from leaving before they read anything.
exzh: 網站最佳化讓網頁載入更快，避免訪客還沒讀內容就離開。

en: She wants to study anthropology at university to learn how different cultures live and think.
exzh: 她想在大學念人類學，了解不同文化如何生活與思考。

en: We picked ripe blackberries along the path and made jam with them at home.
exzh: 我們沿著小徑採了熟透的黑莓，回家用它們做果醬。

en: The competition attracted athletes of such high caliber that every race was exciting.
exzh: 這場比賽吸引了水準極高的選手，每場賽事都很精采。
note: 英式拼法 calibre；of high caliber 高水準

en: We reached the crest of the hill just in time to watch the sun come up.
exzh: 我們及時爬到山丘頂端，看到日出。

en: The two chess champions fought a thrilling duel that lasted for more than six hours.
exzh: 這兩位西洋棋冠軍進行了一場持續六個多小時的精彩對決。

en: In the children's story, a tiny elf lives in the forest and helps lost travelers.
exzh: 在這則兒童故事裡，一個小小的精靈住在森林中，幫助迷路的旅人。

en: The photo was fuzzy because the camera moved while I was taking the picture.
exzh: 那張照片很模糊，因為我拍照時相機晃動了。
note: 亦指毛茸茸的 fuzzy toy

en: The old gothic cathedral has tall pointed windows and a roof that seems to reach the sky.
exzh: 那座古老的哥德式大教堂有高高的尖拱窗和彷彿直達天際的屋頂。

en: The city invited artists to paint colorful graffiti on the long wall near the station.
exzh: 市府邀請藝術家在車站附近的長牆上畫上色彩繽紛的塗鴉。

en: They live in a quiet hamlet with only a few houses and one small shop.
exzh: 他們住在一個寧靜的小村落，只有幾戶人家和一間小商店。

en: The captain stood at the helm and carefully steered the ship through the narrow channel.
exzh: 船長站在舵旁，小心地操縱船隻通過狹窄的水道。
note: at the helm 掌舵、領導

en: The children laughed as they ran through the garden maze, trying to find the way out.
exzh: 孩子們笑著跑過花園迷宮，想找到出口。

en: The monks in the mountain monastery grow vegetables and live a quiet, simple life.
exzh: 山上寺院裡的僧侶們種植蔬菜，過著安靜簡單的生活。

en: Scientists study mutations in genes to learn why some plants can grow in salty soil.
exzh: 科學家研究基因的突變，想了解為什麼有些植物能在鹹的土壤中生長。

en: The optic nerve carries signals from your eye to your brain so you can see.
exzh: 視神經把訊號從眼睛傳到大腦，讓你能夠看見。
note: optic nerve 視神經；optical 較常見

en: The black panther moved quietly through the forest, hunting at night while other animals slept.
exzh: 黑豹在森林中悄悄移動，在其他動物睡覺的夜裡獵食。

en: The runner passed the baton to her teammate, who sprinted toward the finish line.
exzh: 那位跑者把接力棒交給隊友，隊友便向終點線衝刺。

en: The boat stopped in a quiet cove where the water was calm and clear.
exzh: 船停在一個寧靜的小海灣，那裡的海水平靜又清澈。

en: The store window displayed a dummy wearing the latest winter jacket.
exzh: 商店櫥窗裡陳列著一個穿著最新冬季外套的人體模特兒。
note: 亦指奶嘴（英式）；罵人『笨蛋』較不禮貌

en: Our class visited the science expo, where companies showed new robots and solar-powered cars.
exzh: 我們班參觀了科學博覽會，各家公司在那裡展示新型機器人和太陽能車。

en: The kitten chased a ball of yarn across the floor and then fell asleep in the sun.
exzh: 小貓追著一團毛線球跑過地板，然後在陽光下睡著了。

en: Several municipalities worked together to build a new recycling center for the region.
exzh: 幾個市政單位合作為這個地區興建了一座新的資源回收中心。

en: Scientists found a mutant plant whose flowers were bigger than the usual ones.
exzh: 科學家發現了一株突變的植物，花朵比一般的更大。

en: Plastic bags are made from a polymer, a long chain of small molecules joined together.
exzh: 塑膠袋是由聚合物製成的，也就是由許多小分子連成的長鏈。

en: The farmer's dog gave birth to a healthy pup, and the children were delighted to see it.
exzh: 農夫的狗生下一隻健康的小狗，孩子們看到都很開心。
note: 也可指海豹、狼等的幼獸

en: The bird has scarlet feathers on its chest that shine in the morning sun.
exzh: 那隻鳥的胸前有猩紅色的羽毛，在晨光下閃閃發亮。

en: A small red flag was placed atop the highest tower of the old castle.
exzh: 一面小紅旗插在這座古堡最高塔樓的頂端。
note: 文學、較正式；= on top of

en: Clearing your browser's cache can fix problems when a website does not load properly.
exzh: 清除瀏覽器的快取可以解決網站無法正常載入的問題。
note: 電腦用語；亦指祕密儲藏處

en: The comedian's best gag was about a robot that was too lazy to clean the house.
exzh: 這位喜劇演員最棒的笑點，是關於一個懶得打掃房子的機器人。
note: 另有動詞義「使作嘔；塞住嘴」

en: In ancient Greece, winners of the games were given a crown made of laurel leaves.
exzh: 在古希臘，比賽的優勝者會得到一頂用月桂葉做成的冠冕。
note: rest on one's laurels 滿足於過往成就

en: The winner stepped onto the podium and smiled as the crowd clapped loudly.
exzh: 優勝者踏上頒獎台微笑著，群眾用力鼓掌。

en: Tofu is made from soy, and it is a common source of protein in many Asian dishes.
exzh: 豆腐是用大豆做成的，是許多亞洲料理中常見的蛋白質來源。

en: Leaving the wooden board in the rain will cause it to warp and become useless.
exzh: 把木板留在雨中會使它變形彎曲，變得不能用。

en: Alpine plants are small and grow close to the ground to survive strong winds.
exzh: 高山植物很矮小，貼著地面生長，才能在強風中生存。

en: Frogs and fish are aquatic animals that spend much of their lives in water.
exzh: 青蛙和魚是水生動物，一生中大部分時間都待在水裡。

en: Streaming high-quality video uses a lot of bandwidth, so the internet may slow down.
exzh: 串流高畫質影片會用掉很多頻寬，所以網路可能會變慢。

en: Every magnet is bipolar, with a north pole at one end and a south pole at the other.
exzh: 每塊磁鐵都是雙極的，一端是北極，另一端是南極。
note: 醫學上 bipolar disorder 指躁鬱症

en: The bladder stores liquid waste until it is time to go to the toilet.
exzh: 膀胱負責儲存尿液，直到要上廁所的時候。

en: The family traveled across the country in a caravan and slept beside lakes at night.
exzh: 這家人搭著露營拖車橫越全國，晚上就睡在湖邊。
note: 英式指露營拖車；亦指沙漠中的商旅隊

en: The compressed file is much smaller, so it is easier to send by email.
exzh: 壓縮過的檔案小很多，所以比較容易用電子郵件寄出。

en: A strong gale blew across the harbor, and all the fishing boats stayed in port.
exzh: 一陣強風吹過港口，所有的漁船都留在港內。

en: Some people cannot eat gluten, which is found in bread, noodles, and many cakes.
exzh: 有些人不能吃麩質，麩質存在於麵包、麵條與許多蛋糕裡。

en: Our school mascot is a friendly tiger that appears at every sports day.
exzh: 我們學校的吉祥物是一隻友善的老虎，出現在每次運動會上。

en: Regular exercise can improve your metabolic rate and help your body use energy more efficiently.
exzh: 規律運動可以提高你的新陳代謝率，幫助身體更有效率地使用能量。

en: Visitors rested in a wooden pavilion in the garden and enjoyed the cool breeze from the lake.
exzh: 遊客在花園的木亭裡休息，享受從湖面吹來的涼風。
note: 世博會的「展館」也用 pavilion

en: The job has many perks, such as free lunch and flexible working hours.
exzh: 這份工作有許多額外福利，像是免費午餐與彈性工時。

en: Lions and zebras live on the African savannah, where the grass is tall and dry.
exzh: 獅子和斑馬生活在非洲熱帶大草原，那裡的草又高又乾。

en: The factory's shutdown for repairs lasted a week, and the workers took the time to rest.
exzh: 工廠為了維修停工一週，工人利用這段時間休息。

en: My grandmother has arthritis in her hands, so opening jars is difficult for her.
exzh: 我的奶奶手部有關節炎，所以打開罐子對她來說很困難。

en: A beaver cuts down small trees with its sharp teeth to build a dam in the river.
exzh: 河狸用鋒利的牙齒咬倒小樹，在河裡築起水壩。

en: He turned the crank slowly, and the old music box began to play a soft song.
exzh: 他緩緩轉動手搖柄，老舊的音樂盒便開始播放柔和的曲子。
note: 動詞 crank up 把…開大

en: The fire station dispatched two trucks as soon as it received the emergency call.
exzh: 消防隊一接到緊急電話就派出了兩輛消防車。
note: 亦可作名詞，指派遣、急件

en: My brother is a computer geek who spends his weekends building small robots.
exzh: 我哥哥是個電腦狂熱者，週末都在組裝小型機器人。

en: The sailor stood at the lookout and watched for rocks in the dark water.
exzh: 水手站在瞭望台上，注意黑暗海水中的礁石。
note: be on the lookout for 留意…

en: A large moose walked slowly across the snowy field near the forest.
exzh: 一隻大駝鹿慢慢走過森林附近的雪地。

en: In the sentence "The dog barked," the word "dog" is a noun because it names an animal.
exzh: 在「The dog barked」這個句子中，dog 是名詞，因為它指稱一種動物。

en: Pilots practice in a flight simulator before they fly a real airplane for the first time.
exzh: 飛行員在第一次駕駛真正的飛機之前，會先在飛行模擬器上練習。

zh: 狂歡式的放縱；一口氣大量做某事
en: After the exams, she went on a TV binge and watched her favorite series all weekend.
exzh: 考完試後，她一口氣狂追劇，整個週末都在看她最愛的影集。

en: Calculus helps engineers understand how things change, such as speed and the shape of curves.
exzh: 微積分幫助工程師了解事物如何變化，例如速度和曲線的形狀。
note: 數學：微積分；醫學：結石（kidney stone）

en: Use a colon before a list, as in "Bring three things: a pen, paper, and water."
exzh: 在列舉項目前使用冒號，例如「帶三樣東西：筆、紙和水」。
note: 也是人體「結腸」；此句為標點用法

en: The sky turned crimson as the sun slowly sank behind the hills.
exzh: 當太陽慢慢沉到山後，天空染成深紅色。

en: The ring has a large emerald that shines with a deep green color.
exzh: 這枚戒指上有一顆大祖母綠，閃著深綠色的光芒。

en: She has practiced gymnastics since she was six and can now do a perfect backflip.
exzh: 她從六歲開始練體操，現在能完美地做出後空翻。
note: 視為單數；artistic gymnastics 競技體操

en: The old mystic lived alone in the mountains and spent his days thinking about life and nature.
exzh: 那位老神祕主義者獨自住在山裡，整天思考生命與自然。

en: The city passed an ordinance that bans plastic bags in all local supermarkets.
exzh: 市府通過了一項條例，禁止所有當地超市使用塑膠袋。

en: Workers cut large blocks of stone from the quarry and send them to the city.
exzh: 工人從採石場切下大塊石頭，運往城市。
note: 另一意思為被追捕的獵物

en: Maple trees produce a sweet sap that people collect in spring to make syrup.
exzh: 楓樹會產生甜甜的樹液，人們在春天採集它來製作糖漿。

en: Good ventilation in the classroom keeps the air fresh and helps students stay awake and focused.
exzh: 教室良好的通風讓空氣新鮮，也幫助學生保持清醒和專注。

en: My uncle is a history buff who knows many stories about old castles and battles.
exzh: 我叔叔是個歷史迷，知道許多關於古老城堡和戰役的故事。

en: The kitten has soft, fluffy fur, and everyone in the class wants to hold it.
exzh: 那隻小貓有柔軟蓬鬆的毛，班上每個人都想抱抱牠。

en: Red poppies covered the hillside, making the whole field look like a bright carpet.
exzh: 紅色的虞美人開滿山坡，讓整片田野看起來像一張鮮豔的地毯。

en: Strong abdominal muscles help support your back and keep your body balanced when you play sports.
exzh: 強健的腹部肌肉能支撐你的背部，讓你運動時保持身體平衡。

en: A sudden blackout left the whole street dark, so we lit candles and played cards.
exzh: 突然的停電讓整條街陷入一片黑暗，所以我們點起蠟燭玩牌。

en: He tried to bluff his way through the quiz, but the teacher saw he had not studied.
exzh: 他想靠虛張聲勢蒙混過小考，但老師看出他沒有念書。
note: 亦可作名詞，指虛張聲勢或懸崖

zh: 俗氣的；老套的；有起司味的
en: The pizza was cheesy and hot, and everyone at the table asked for another slice.
exzh: 披薩起司滿滿又熱騰騰，桌上每個人都再要了一片。
note: 口語中亦指俗套、肉麻的 cheesy joke

en: Citrus fruits such as oranges and lemons are rich in vitamin C and help protect your body.
exzh: 柳橙和檸檬等柑橘類水果富含維生素 C，有助於保護身體。
note: 也可作形容詞，如 citrus fruit

en: The hikers, clad in thick jackets, walked slowly up the snowy mountain path.
exzh: 身穿厚外套的登山客，沿著積雪的山徑慢慢往上走。
note: clad in 穿著；為文學或正式用語

en: The whole class sent their condolences to the teacher after her grandmother passed away.
exzh: 她的祖母過世後，全班向老師表達慰問之意。
note: send/offer one's condolences 表達哀悼

en: Warm air flows through the metal duct and heats every room in the building.
exzh: 暖空氣經過金屬管道，讓大樓裡的每個房間都暖和起來。
note: air duct 通風管；tear duct 淚管

en: Light, radio waves, and X-rays are all kinds of electromagnetic waves that travel through space.
exzh: 光、無線電波和 X 光都是在太空中傳播的電磁波。

en: Butterfly larvae eat a lot of leaves before they turn into pupae and later into butterflies.
exzh: 蝴蝶的幼蟲在變成蛹、再變成蝴蝶之前，會吃很多葉子。

en: Bananas are rich in potassium, a mineral that helps your muscles and heart work well.
exzh: 香蕉富含鉀，這種礦物質能幫助你的肌肉與心臟正常運作。

en: To see the next photo, just swipe your finger to the left on the screen.
exzh: 要看下一張照片，只要在螢幕上用手指向左滑動就可以了。

en: The painting was made circa 1850, though nobody knows the exact year it was finished.
exzh: 這幅畫約作於一八五〇年，但沒有人知道確切的完成年份。
note: 縮寫 c. 或 ca.，用於年代

en: Good research papers include citations so that readers can find the original sources.
exzh: 好的研究報告會附上引用資料，讓讀者能找到原始出處。

en: She put on a warm cloak before walking out into the cold evening wind.
exzh: 她披上一件暖和的斗篷，才走進寒冷的傍晚風中。
note: 亦可作動詞，表示遮蔽、掩飾

en: Fuel needs oxygen for combustion, which is why fires need air to keep burning.
exzh: 燃料燃燒需要氧氣，這就是為什麼火需要空氣才能持續燃燒。

en: Tonight the moon is a thin crescent, and it looks like a smile in the sky.
exzh: 今晚的月亮是一彎細細的新月，看起來像天空中的笑臉。

en: The historian wrote about the deportation of thousands of workers from the island in the 1800s.
exzh: 歷史學家寫到十九世紀有數千名工人被驅逐出島的事。

en: In the old castle, visitors can walk down the stairs and see the dark dungeon.
exzh: 在那座古堡裡，遊客可以走下樓梯，參觀陰暗的地牢。

en: A fiery sunset painted the sky orange and red above the quiet harbor.
exzh: 火紅的夕陽把寧靜港口上方的天空染成橘色和紅色。
note: 亦指脾氣火爆、言詞激烈

en: My little brother made a goofy face in the photo, and now the whole family loves it.
exzh: 我弟弟在照片裡做了個傻呼呼的鬼臉，現在全家人都很喜歡。

en: Please do not hog the computer, because other students are also waiting to use it.
exzh: 請不要霸佔電腦，因為其他學生也在等著用。
note: 口語動詞用法；名詞則指（大型）豬

en: The inauguration of the new library was held on a sunny Saturday morning.
exzh: 新圖書館的落成典禮在一個陽光明媚的週六早晨舉行。

en: Scientists used special scans to study the mummy without damaging its ancient cloth wrappings.
exzh: 科學家用特殊掃描研究這具木乃伊，而不損壞它古老的裹布。

en: The rhino is protected in many parks because its numbers have dropped sharply over the years.
exzh: 犀牛在許多公園受到保護，因為牠們的數量多年來大幅下降。

en: Many old buildings in the town were built with warm, golden sandstone from nearby hills.
exzh: 鎮上許多老建築是用附近山丘出產的金黃色砂岩蓋成的。

en: The venom of some snakes can be turned into medicine to help people with heart problems.
exzh: 有些蛇的毒液可以製成藥物，幫助有心臟問題的人。
note: 形容詞 venomous 有毒的

en: After vaccination, the body makes antibodies that help it fight the germ in the future.
exzh: 接種疫苗後，身體會產生抗體，幫助它日後對抗病菌。

en: Scientists believe that a huge asteroid hit the Earth millions of years ago and changed its climate.
exzh: 科學家相信數百萬年前有一顆巨大小行星撞擊地球，改變了地球的氣候。

en: Doctors explained how chemotherapy uses special medicine to treat patients with cancer.
exzh: 醫生解釋了化學治療如何使用特殊藥物來治療癌症病人。

en: After hitting his head in the game, the player was checked for a concussion.
exzh: 那名球員在比賽中撞到頭之後，被檢查是否腦震盪。

en: She visited the consulate to get a visa before her study trip abroad.
exzh: 她去領事館辦簽證，準備出國遊學。
note: consulate 比 embassy（大使館）層級低

en: The old graveyard behind the church is quiet, and some of the stones are more than two hundred years old.
exzh: 教堂後面的老墓園很安靜，有些墓碑已有兩百多年歷史。

en: Most rechargeable phone batteries contain lithium because it can store a lot of energy.
exzh: 大多數可充電的手機電池都含有鋰，因為它能儲存大量能量。

en: Scientists use telescopes to study planetary movements and the atmospheres of distant worlds.
exzh: 科學家用望遠鏡研究行星的運動與遙遠世界的大氣。

en: A faster processor lets the computer open large files and run many programs smoothly.
exzh: 更快的處理器能讓電腦順暢地開啟大型檔案並同時執行許多程式。

en: Schizophrenia is a mental health condition that doctors treat with medicine and long-term support.
exzh: 思覺失調症是一種心理健康疾病，醫生以藥物和長期支持來治療。

en: After getting her first pay, she went on a shopping spree and bought new clothes.
exzh: 領到第一份薪水後，她大肆採購了一番，買了新衣服。

en: The jacket is made of faux leather, so no animals were harmed to make it.
exzh: 這件夾克是用人造皮製成的，所以製作過程沒有傷害任何動物。
note: faux fur 人造毛皮；源自法語

zh: 贈品；免費贈送活動；洩漏跡象
en: The bookstore ran a giveaway and handed out free notebooks to the first fifty customers.
exzh: 書店舉辦贈品活動，把免費筆記本送給前五十位顧客。
note: a dead giveaway 一眼就看穿的破綻

en: We lay on the grass and counted every meteor that streaked across the dark night sky.
exzh: 我們躺在草地上，數著每一顆劃過漆黑夜空的流星。

en: The airline offers free onboard meals on all flights that last longer than four hours.
exzh: 航空公司在所有超過四小時的航班上，提供免費的機上餐點。
note: 也可寫成 on board；歡迎加入說 welcome aboard

en: His joke was a clever pun that used two meanings of the same word.
exzh: 他的笑話是個聰明的雙關語，用了同一個字的兩種意思。
note: play on words 的同義說法

en: The city built a new plant to clean sewage before it flows back into the river.
exzh: 這座城市蓋了一座新的處理廠，在污水流回河川前先予以淨化。

en: Titanium is strong yet light, so it is used in bicycles, airplanes, and some medical tools.
exzh: 鈦既堅固又輕，所以被用在腳踏車、飛機和一些醫療器材上。

en: Green algae grow quickly in warm ponds and can turn the water a bright color.
exzh: 綠藻在溫暖的池塘中生長迅速，可能使水變成鮮豔的顏色。
note: 複數形，單數 alga 少用

en: Old buildings may contain asbestos, so workers must wear masks when they remove it.
exzh: 老建築可能含有石綿，所以工人在拆除時必須戴口罩。

en: After walking in circles, we stopped to get our bearings with a map and a compass.
exzh: 繞了幾圈之後，我們停下來用地圖和指南針確認方位。
note: get / lose one's bearings 找到／迷失方向；機械義：軸承

en: She found a lovely scarf in a small boutique that sells clothes made by local designers.
exzh: 她在一家販售在地設計師作品的小精品店裡找到一條漂亮的圍巾。

en: The little girl had curly hair and bright hazel eyes that looked green in the sunlight.
exzh: 那個小女孩有一頭捲髮和明亮的淡褐色眼睛，在陽光下看起來帶綠色。

en: The inscription on the stone tells us who built the temple and when.
exzh: 石頭上的碑文告訴我們是誰、在什麼時候建了這座廟。

en: Cows release methane, a gas that traps heat and adds to global warming.
exzh: 牛會排放甲烷，這種氣體會鎖住熱能，加劇全球暖化。

en: The boat rocked so much that several passengers felt nausea and had to sit down.
exzh: 船搖晃得很厲害，好幾位乘客覺得噁心而必須坐下來。

en: A neurological exam checks how well the brain and nerves control the body's movements.
exzh: 神經學檢查會確認大腦與神經對身體動作的控制是否良好。

en: The painting shows a calm pastoral scene with sheep eating grass beside a stream.
exzh: 這幅畫呈現寧靜的田園景象，羊群在溪邊吃草。

en: A robotic arm in the factory lifts heavy boxes and places them on the shelves.
exzh: 工廠裡的機械手臂會搬起沉重的箱子，把它們放到架上。
note: 亦可形容動作僵硬、機械式

en: The writer spent two years working on the screenplay before the film could start shooting.
exzh: 這位編劇花了兩年寫劇本，電影才得以開拍。

en: Taiwan sits on a seismic belt, so buildings here are designed to resist earthquakes.
exzh: 臺灣位在地震帶上，所以這裡的建築物都設計成能抵抗地震。

en: The squirrel kept a secret stash of nuts under the tree for the winter.
exzh: 松鼠在樹下藏了一堆堅果，準備過冬。

en: In the picture book, a white unicorn with a golden horn lived in a quiet forest.
exzh: 在這本繪本裡，一隻長著金色獨角的白色獨角獸住在寧靜的森林中。
note: 商業用語：估值超過十億美元的新創公司

en: Students in the vocational program learn welding, which joins pieces of metal together using intense heat.
exzh: 職業班的學生學習焊接，也就是用高溫把金屬片接合在一起。

en: On hot summer days, the black asphalt on the road becomes soft and very warm.
exzh: 炎熱的夏日裡，路上的黑色柏油會變軟，而且非常燙。

en: The coach stopped the brawl between the two teams before anyone got hurt.
exzh: 教練在有人受傷之前，制止了兩隊之間的混戰。

en: The stars, planets, and moon are celestial objects that people have studied for centuries.
exzh: 星星、行星和月亮都是人類研究了數百年的天體。

en: A fungus grew on the old bread because it had been left in a warm, damp place.
exzh: 那塊舊麵包被放在溫暖潮濕的地方，所以長出了黴菌。

en: Different localities in the country have their own special foods and local festivals.
exzh: 這個國家不同的地區有各自特別的食物和在地節慶。

en: Crocodiles lurk under the water near the riverbank, waiting for animals to come to drink.
exzh: 鱷魚潛伏在河岸邊的水面下，等著動物前來喝水。

en: Bone marrow makes new blood cells that carry oxygen around the body.
exzh: 骨髓會製造新的血球，將氧氣運送到全身。
note: bone marrow 骨髓；英式亦指一種大型南瓜

en: My fingers were numb after playing in the snow without gloves for half an hour.
exzh: 沒戴手套在雪中玩了半小時後，我的手指都麻了。

en: In chess, a pawn can move forward one square, and it may become a queen later.
exzh: 在西洋棋裡，兵一次可以往前走一格，之後還可能升變為后。
note: 另有動詞 pawn 指典當

en: The hospital has a pediatric ward with colorful walls and toys to help children relax.
exzh: 這家醫院有一間小兒病房，牆壁色彩繽紛，還有玩具幫助孩子放鬆。
note: 名詞 pediatrician 小兒科醫師

en: During recess, the children ran outside to play basketball and eat their snacks.
exzh: 下課休息時間，孩子們跑到外面打籃球、吃點心。
note: 美式指學校下課；亦指議會休會

en: Rainwater runoff from farms can carry fertilizer into rivers and harm the fish living there.
exzh: 農地的雨水逕流可能把肥料帶進河裡，傷害住在裡面的魚。

en: The old house looked spooky at night, with its broken windows and long shadows.
exzh: 那棟老房子在夜裡看起來陰森森的，有破碎的窗戶和長長的影子。

en: The cat moved with great stealth across the garden, trying not to scare the birds.
exzh: 那隻貓悄悄地穿過花園，不想嚇到鳥兒。

en: Could you turn the music down just a tad? I am trying to study.
exzh: 你可以把音樂稍微調小一點點嗎？我正在讀書。

en: The thyroid is a small gland in your neck that helps control how your body uses energy.
exzh: 甲狀腺是頸部的一個小腺體，幫助控制身體如何使用能量。

en: Her adrenaline rose as she stood at the starting line, waiting for the race to begin.
exzh: 當她站在起跑線等待比賽開始時，腎上腺素飆升。
note: adrenaline rush 腎上腺素激增

en: The passengers walked ashore after the ship arrived safely in the small harbor.
exzh: 船安全抵達小港口後，乘客們走上岸。

en: Sunlight hardly reaches the ground because the thick canopy of the rainforest blocks it.
exzh: 雨林濃密的樹冠層擋住了陽光，所以幾乎沒有陽光能照到地面。
